description_html:
Mehr als nur ein Job

Du kennst den gewerblichen Photovoltaikmarkt, kannst Türen öffnen und möchtest einen Geschäftsbereich aktiv mitentwickeln? Dann wollen wir dich kennenlernen.

heimWatt realisiert Photovoltaikprojekte für Gewerbe, Industrie, Wohnungswirtschaft und weitere professionelle Auftraggeber. Durch die Integration wesentlicher Geschäftsbereiche der Energiegewinner Technik GmbH haben wir unsere Kompetenz für größere PV-Projekte deutlich ausgebaut.

Jetzt wollen wir weiter wachsen. Als Sales Manager – Gewerbliche Photovoltaik (m/w/d) entwickelst du neue Kunden, Projekte und Partnerschaften im Bereich von 30 kWp bis 1 MW und begleitest sie vom ersten Kontakt bis zum Vertragsabschluss.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Potenzielle Kunden und Projekte im gewerblichen Photovoltaikbereich identifizierst du gezielt und sprichst die passenden Entscheider direkt an.
  • Die Anforderungen deiner Kunden verstehst du genau und berätst sie zu wirtschaftlich und technisch passenden PV-Lösungen.
  • Gemeinsam mit unserer Projektentwicklung erarbeitest du Angebote, präsentierst diese beim Kunden und führst die Verhandlungen bis zum Vertragsabschluss.
  • Deine Verkaufschancen verfolgst du konsequent und hältst Aktivitäten, nächste Schritte und Prognosen im CRM aktuell.
  • Langfristige Beziehungen zu Kunden, Partnern und Empfehlungsgebern baust du aktiv auf und entwickelst daraus neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.
  • Neue Marktpotenziale und attraktive Kundensegmente erkennst du frühzeitig und bringst deine Erfahrungen und Ideen aktiv in unseren Vertrieb ein.
  • Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss sorgst du für eine strukturierte Übergabe an Planung und Realisierung


Dein Profil

Du passt zu uns, wenn du:

  • bereits Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb von Photovoltaik-, Energie-, Immobilien- oder vergleichbaren technischen B2B-Projekten gesammelt hast
  • den Markt für gewerbliche Photovoltaikanlagen kennst und idealerweise bereits über ein eigenes Netzwerk verfügst
  • Erfahrung in der aktiven Neukundenakquise mitbringst
  • komplexere Investitionsentscheidungen und längere B2B-Sales-Cycles gewohnt bist
  • selbstständig arbeitest und Verantwortung für deine Pipeline und deine Ergebnisse übernimmst
  • auf Geschäftsführungs- und Entscheiderebene sicher kommunizieren kannst
  • nicht nur verkaufen, sondern langfristige Kunden- und Partnerbeziehungen aufbauen möchtest
  • unternehmerisch denkst und Lust darauf hast, neue Strukturen mitzugestalten
  • ein bestehendes Netzwerk zu potenziellen Kunden oder Multiplikationspartnern ist ein großes Plus


Warum wir?

  • Du steigst in ein etabliertes Geschäftsfeld mit erfahrenen Teams, technischer Kompetenz und Referenzen aus größeren PV-Projekten ein.
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum gibt dir die Möglichkeit, deinen Markt und neue Vertriebswege eigenständig zu entwickeln.
  • Dich erwartet ein attraktives Vergütungspaket, das deine Erfahrung und deinen vertrieblichen Erfolg berücksichtigt.
  • Für Kundentermine und Partnergespräche stellen wir dir einen Firmenwagen zur Verfügung.
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und die enge Zusammenarbeit mit Projektentwicklung, Technik und Geschäftsführung sorgen dafür, dass Ideen schnell umgesetzt werden können.
  • Mit dem Wachstum unseres Commercial-Geschäfts wächst auch dein Verantwortungsbereich – und damit deine persönliche Entwicklungsperspektive.
  • Du arbeitest in einem Markt mit großem Potenzial und hilfst Unternehmen dabei, Dachflächen wirtschaftlich zu nutzen und ihre Energieversorgung zukunftsfähig aufzustellen.
  • Außerdem bieten wir dir:
    • 30 Tage Urlaub
    • Home-Office Möglichkeit 
    • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
    • Regelmäßige lockere Firmenevents

description_html:

Du hast Erfahrung mit Photovoltaikanlagen, kennst dich auf der AC-Seite aus und möchtest größere PV-Projekte eigenverantwortlich begleiten? Dann wollen wir dich kennenlernen.

Als Elektriker Photovoltaik Großprojekte (m/w/d) übernimmst du Verantwortung für die elektrotechnische Umsetzung unserer PV-Projekte – von der Planung über die Installation bis zur Inbetriebnahme. Dabei arbeitest du sowohl im Büro als auch direkt auf unseren Projekten vor Ort.

Bei uns bekommst du viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, deine Erfahrung in einem wachsenden Zukunftsmarkt einzubringen.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Die AC-seitige Planung und Umsetzung unserer Photovoltaikanlagen begleitest du eigenverantwortlich von der Vorbereitung bis zur Inbetriebnahme
  • Vor, während und zum Abschluss der Projekte führst du Begehungen durch und stellst eine fachgerechte Ausführung sicher
  • Wechselrichter, Batteriespeicher und Zählerschränke schließt du fachgerecht an und nimmst die PV-Systeme in Betrieb

  • Prüfungen, Messungen und die erforderliche Dokumentation führst du nach den geltenden VDE-Richtlinien durch
  • Nachunternehmen steuerst du vor Ort und arbeitest eng mit unseren Montageteams und der Projektleitung zusammen
  • Bei Abnahmen, Nacharbeiten und der Behebung von Mängeln übernimmst du die elektrotechnische Verantwortung
  • Deine Erfahrung bringst du außerdem in die Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Standards für den AC-Anschluss von PV-Anlagen ein


Dein Profil

  • Energiewende, Klimaschutz und Energieeffizienz sind Themen, für die du dich begeistern kannst


Warum wir?

  • Du übernimmst eine verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe in einer Zukunftsbranche und arbeitest direkt an der Umsetzung der Energiewende mit
  • Viel Eigenverantwortung und hohe Freiheitsgrade geben dir die Möglichkeit, deine Arbeit selbstständig zu gestalten
  • Statt klassischer Montage erwartet dich eine abwechslungsreiche Mischung aus Projektplanung im Büro und Einsätzen auf unseren Projekten vor Ort
  • Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein kollegiales Miteinander prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit
  • Mit Weiterbildungen und Schulungen unterstützen wir dich dabei, dein Know-how weiter auszubauen.
  • Fachlich kannst du dich von klassischen PV-Anlagen bis hin zu großen Projekten im Megawattbereich weiterentwickeln und perspektivisch auch Kolleginnen und Kollegen anleiten
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, regelmäßige Firmenevents und eine gute Teamkultur gehören für uns ebenfalls dazu
  • 30 Tage Urlaub und ein hoher Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge runden unser Angebot ab

title: Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Dornier MedTech GmbH
description_html:
Ihre Aufgaben

Development, implementation, construction and testing of electrical components and for medical products, which represent state-of-the-art technology. The job holder closely collaborates with stakeholders across department and operational structures, particularly with engineers from other groups such as systems engineering, quality engineering, software development but also regulatory affairs and quality management.
Focus is on delivering innovative solutions that meet customer requirements as well as regulatory requirements, particularly those related to safety and effectiveness. The deliverables contribute to increasing the competitiveness and commercial success of Dornier MedTech and its subsidiaries. Solutions are provided in a cost- and time-efficient manner and by strong collaboration with stakeholders across department and operational structures.
Specific Responsibilities

  • Development and implementation of power and control electronic boards for complex medical devices.
  • Creation of electrical circuit and wiring diagrams for complex medical devices.
  • Development and implementation of electrical safety concepts to assure product functional safety.
  • Implementation and execution of concepts for product cost reduction.
  • Collection and determination of technical requirements and specifications.
  • Create component and system specifications and other quality related documents such as risk analysis, DFMEA, test and verification reports, etc. in compliance with international requirements (CE, FDA, MHLW).
  • Perform verification tests to verify electrical components and product requirements.
  • Maintain products and systems to ensure stable and reliable operations as part of the product lifecycle management process.
  • Support of troubleshooting electrical-related issues in production
  • Performing of engineering tasks during setup and start-up of prototypes
  • As needed, coordinate, organize, and track engineering tasks on a task- or project-specific basis
  • Assisting the project management with the planning of engineering-related tasks
  • Representation of the Engineering department in project team meetings
  • Coordinate and work with third-party suppliers and contractors
  • Monitoring of technological trends in electronics, including reviews of competitors' technology.


Ihr Profil

  • Masters’s degree in science and engineering with experience in R&D
  • Specialization in electrical engineering
  • At least 7 years of experience in the development of electrical devices, preferably medical systems.
  • Advanced knowledge of electronics (power-, digital-, analog- and microprocessor technology).
  • Experienced in design and development of power and digital electronic boards.
  • In-depth knowledge of EMI/EMC design principles and electrical safety requirements
  • Experience in creating electrical schematics and circuit diagrams
  • Experience working with PC-controlled systems
  • Experienced in creating technical reference documentation
  • Knowledge in requirements and systems engineering
  • Experienced in performing Design Transfer to production
  • Creativity and Analytical Skills
  • Assertiveness
  • Demonstrated ability to work and contribute in a team environment
  • Strong work ethic with pride in individual accomplishments
  • Interested in personal and professional growth for her-/himself and team
  • Entrepreneurial spirit very helpful in a small but global organization
  • Motivated and creative, ability to “think outside the box”
  • Be able to function independently of direct supervision
  • Standards knowledge: ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR 820.30, IEC 14971, IEC 62366, IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2 and collateral standards
  • Ms Office; Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint
  • Knowledge in ERP system; Preferably Infor SyteLine
  • Knowledge in Altium, Eagle, OrCAD PSpice, Multiphysics simulation, MATLAB
  • Knowledge in requirement management tool such as DOORS, Polarion or CodeBeamer
  • Knowledge in building PCB prototypes and system cabling


Warum wir?

  • Personal induction plan and comprehensive onboarding
  • Flexible working hours
  • 30 days of holiday
  • interesting tasks in a dynamic, international environment
  • Continuous training and development
  • Flat hierarchies
  • Attractive canteen
  • Free coffee, tea and water
  • Employee events
  • Charging stations for electric cars
  • Accident insurance
  • Employer contribution to VWL
  • Employee fund with various allowances and subsidies
  • Free language courses

title: Werkstudent*in Klimafreundliche Schifffahrt und Häfen

company.name: NOW GmbH Nationale Organisation für den Wandel in der ...

salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at NOW GmbH Nationale Organisation für den Wandel in der ...
description_html:
Aufgaben

Als Werkstudent*in unterstützt du bei der Gestaltung, der Umsetzung und dem Monitoring öffentlicher Strategien und Maßnahmen für klimafreundliche Schifffahrt und Häfen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Stakeholdern aus der maritimen Branche.
Im Einzelnen bedeutet dies:

  • Du unterstützt bei Markt-, Potenzial- und Umweltanalysen und der Bewertungen von Technologieoptionen und Geschäftsmodellen für klimafreundliche Schifffahrt und Häfen.

  • Du unterstützt bei Umsetzung, Monitoring und Evaluierung des Nationalen Aktionsplans klimafreundliche Schifffahrt und dessen Maßnahmenprogramms sowie einzelner Maßnahmenumsetzungen im Kontext der Nationalen Hafenstrategie.

  • Du unterstützt Angebots- und Vergabeverfahren, die inhaltliche Begleitung externer Beauftragungen und bei der Erarbeitung von Dokumenten für unsere Auftraggeber.

  • Du unterstützt bei der Fachberatung unserer Auftraggeber im Kontext der Weiterentwicklung von Vorschriften und Standards für alternative Schiffsantriebe und -kraftstoffe.

  • Du unterstützt bei der Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Fördermaßnahmen im Themenfeld klimafreundlicher Schifffahrt und Häfen.

  • Du unterstützt bei der Netzwerkarbeit in Arbeitsgremien mit Behörden, Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft und/oder Verbänden sowie die Kommunikation und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit der NOW GmbH, beispielsweise auch bei der Vorbereitung von Veranstaltungen, Arbeitstreffen und Workshops.


Profil

Unsere Profilbeschreibung enthält eine Vielzahl unterschiedlicher Kompetenzen, welche wir für diese Stelle relevant finden. Bitte bewirb dich auch, wenn nicht alle Punkte zu 100 % auf dich zutreffen.

  • Du studierst in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang der Natur- bzw. Ingenieurwissenschaften, wie Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Antriebstechnik, Schiffstechnik, Verkehrswesen, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Transportwesen, der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Politikwissenschaften, o. ä.
  • Du konntest bereits erste Berufserfahrung über Praktika o. ä. bei Industrie-, Dienstleistungsunternehmen, einem Industrieverband, in der öffentlichen Verwaltung oder einer wissenschaftlichen Einrichtung sammeln.
  • Du hast idealerweise Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen mit Bezug zur maritimen Wirtschaft (wie zu Schifffahrt, Schiffbau, Zuliefererindustrie, Hafenwirtschaft) sowie ein fachliches Verständnis im Bereich alternativer Antriebe und Kraftstoffinfrastrukturen.
  • Du verfügst bestenfalls über Kenntnisse zu Förderprogrammen/-projekten sowie zur Netzwerkarbeit mit Behörden, Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft und/oder Verbänden.
  • Du bist teamfähig, belastbar, zuverlässig und engagiert.
  • Du kannst gute Englischkenntnisse und sehr gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit gängigen MS-Office-Programmen (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) vorweisen.
  • Du identifizierst dich mit der Strategie der NOW zur nachhaltigen Mobilität und willst diese aktiv mit umsetzen.


Wir bieten

Eine Unternehmenskultur, die einerseits auf Professionalität, Vertrauen und Eigeninitiative, andererseits auf Begeisterung für die Arbeit, Fairness, Chancengleichheit und flachen Hierarchien basiert. Zudem bieten wir:

  • Mitgestaltung der Mobilität der Zukunft, d. h. die Mobilitäts- und Antriebswende in ihrer technologischen, gesellschaftlichen und politischen Breite mit voranzubringen.
  • Einblick in das Zusammenwirken von Politik, Verwaltung, Wirtschaft und Wissenschaft in der Verkehrswende.
  • Selbstbestimmtes Arbeiten, eine wertschätzende und fördernde Arbeitsatmosphäre sowie Zusammenarbeit im interdisziplinären Team.
  • Ein bezuschusstes Job-Ticket.
  • Urban Sports Club als zusätzlicher Benefit zur Förderung deiner Gesundheit und Fitness.
  • Moderne Büros und gut ausgestattete Arbeitsplätze in zentraler Lage mit hervorragender ÖPNV-Anbindung.
  • Einen zunächst 12 Monate befristeten Arbeitsvertrag. Eine Verlängerung wird angestrebt.
  • Möglichkeit des mobilen Arbeitens: Bis zu 60 % der Arbeitszeit remote.
  • Wöchentliche Arbeitszeit nach Vereinbarung: idealerweise 19,5 Stunden/Woche, flexible Gestaltung passend zum Stundenplan deines Studiums.
  • Einen Stundenlohn von 15,00 Euro für Student*innen im Bachelorstudium und 16,00 Euro für Student*innen im Masterstudium sowie eine Jahressonderzahlung.

title: (Senior) Financial Accountant Real Estate (m/f/d)

description_html:
Your mission

  • Independently managing the day-to-day financial accounting for our property companies and holding companies
  • Preparing monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB) and Luxembourg GAAP
  • Preparing and submitting VAT returns on time
  • Acting as the point of contact for internal and external stakeholders
  • Preparing the annual tax documentation for the tax advisers
  • Supporting the optimisation of financial processes and systems
  • Contributing to diverse and exciting projects in the finance department, where you can bring your ideas and specialist knowledge to bear


Your profile

  • A degree in a business-related subject specialising in accounting, or a commercial apprenticeship with more than three years’ professional experience; further training, e.g. as a chartered accountant, would be an advantage
  • In-depth knowledge of standard accounting software, ideally DATEV or Business Central
  • A passion for working in a dynamic environment and the ability to maintain an overview even when dealing with a wide range of tasks
  • A strong aptitude for numbers and the ability to quickly grasp interrelationships
  • A conscientious, structured and results-oriented approach to work
  • The ability to work efficiently both independently and as part of a team
  • Good knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel
  • Fluency in spoken and written German at C2 level and English at B2 level


Why us?

  • A growing company with flat hierarchies
  • A wide range of opportunities to shape your role and take on responsibility
  • A dedicated and motivated team
  • Opportunities for further training and development
  • An attractive remuneration package, including a company pension contribution exceeding statutory requirements
  • Flexible working hours
  • Opportunities to keep fit with Urban Sports Club
  • A high-quality working environment in modern offices


Notes regarding your application

We look forward to receiving your application! 

Please fill out our online application form and upload your complete application documents. We will send you a confirmation once we have received your documents.

Please understand that we can only accept your application via the online form!

description_html:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


🌏 Location: You can choose to work in Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, or Spain.
 
Mission: Join us as a Frontend Engineer to craft the web apps that 600,000+ European SMEs rely on every day, from the customer-facing features that make finance simpler to the design system powering every pixel of our product.

➡️ As a Frontend Engineer at Qonto, you will

  • Craft new features for our customers within a squad Team, owning quality from design to production.
  • Grow in technical leadership: lead design discussions, contribute to guild-wide improvement, and raise the bar for developer experience across your peers
  • Be a key player in teamwork with Product, Design, and other Tech stacks
  • Work AI-first: use AI as a default part of how you explore the codebase, draft technical designs, prototype solutions, and accelerate delivery, while keeping strong human judgment and quality standards

➡️  What you can expect: our methodology, the Qonto Way

  • At Qonto, we value diversity and are proud to have 33% non-male in our Frontend guild.
  • You will contribute to and use our own design system and UI library, which we built from scratch.
  • You will be part of a team that is driven by quality. Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates
  • You will have access to best-in-class AI tools (e.g., Claude / Claude Code and internal workflows) and the autonomy to experiment, share learnings, and help scale what works across the guild
  • You will bring your energy and skills to improve the team’s tools and processes at many levels, contributing to a better developer experience for all your peers.
You can watch this interview of Imen, who joined the team as a Lead in January 2023.
 

➡️  Your future team

As a Frontend Engineer, you'll join one of Qonto's squad teams, each with a clear project mission, one team lead, and full product ownership.
You'll be part of a 100+ strong Frontend community within a 500+ Product Engineering department, working in teams of 5 to 10 people alongside Product, Design, and peers from Backend and Mobile.
 
We hold ourselves to high standards, and we've shipped several open-source JS libraries along the way. We almost completed a migration to React. Now is an exciting time to join, especially if you want to hone your expertise in React over the coming years!

➡️ About You

To succeed as a Frontend Engineer at Qonto, you will need to demonstrate:
  1. Proficiency in frontend engineering: you have at least three years of professional experience using React.js, as well as HTML and CSS. We don’t use CSS libraries such as Tailwind, so you will need to know how to write pure CSS.
  2. Attention to detail: you strive for excellence in every aspect of your job. You don’t gloss over minor issues and you understand that great work is the accumulation of many small things done right.
  3. Communication skills: you explain your thoughts in a clear, organized, concise and accurate manner.
  4. AI fluency & good judgment: you can leverage AI to move faster (research, writing, coding, testing) while staying critical, validating outputs, and protecting the product’s reliability and user trust
At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
 
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Keep in mind, we will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates.

Who we are 

N2JSoft is a fast-growing B2B SaaS fintech that specialises in digitising financial processes. description_html:
Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers.

Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, nos solutions s’imposent aujourd’hui comme des références sur le   marché :

N2F : gestion des dépenses professionnelles (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs)

Keeple : gestion RH du quotidien (congés, absences, temps de travail)

L’entreprise est en forte croissance avec une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Notre écosystème d’outils s’est construit progressivement avec la croissance de l’entreprise. Il est aujourd’hui riche mais encore insuffisamment structuré :

  • des outils qui ne communiquent pas toujours efficacement entre eux

  • des données encore partiellement silotées

  • certains processus insuffisamment maîtrisés

  • un potentiel d’automatisation et d’usage de l’IA encore peu exploité

Certaines briques sont déjà portées en interne, mais de manière partielle ou trop manuelle.

Nous créons ce poste pour structurer durablement le SI, fiabiliser les flux et accompagner la montée en maturité de l’organisation.

Ton rôle

Rattaché au CTO, tu interviens de manière transverse sur l’ensemble de l’entreprise.

Le poste est volontairement hybride : à la fois stratégique et opérationnel. L’objectif n’est pas uniquement de piloter, mais de comprendre, structurer et mettre en œuvre.

Tu travailles en lien étroit avec le CODIR et les équipes métiers.

Tes responsabilités

Structuration du SI et des flux

  • Cartographier les outils et les flux existants

  • Identifier les points de friction et les incohérences

  • Structurer la circulation de la donnée (clients, prospects, finance…)

  • Concevoir et faire évoluer les intégrations entre les systèmes

L’objectif est d’éliminer les silos et de fiabiliser les échanges de données.

Reprise en main des sujets critiques

  • Monter en compétence sur les outils clés, notamment la facturation

  • Fiabiliser les processus existants

  • Réduire la dépendance aux tâches manuelles via l’automatisation

Pilotage de l’écosystème outils

  • Recueillir et challenger les besoins des équipes métiers

  • Définir une logique cohérente d’évolution du SI

  • Arbitrer entre amélioration de l’existant et mise en place de nouveaux outils

  • Piloter les projets SI de bout en bout

Management d’équipe

  • Encadrer une équipe de 3 développeurs

  • Prioriser les sujets en fonction des enjeux business

  • Structurer le backlog et assurer l’alignement avec les besoins de l’entreprise

Développement des usages IA

  • Identifier des cas d’usage concrets avec les équipes

  • Prototyper et déployer des solutions

  • Accompagner l’adoption


Ce que tu apportes

  • 6 à 10 ans d’expérience en SI applicatif, Business Systems ou équivalent

  • Une expérience en environnement SaaS (idéalement dans des structures de 200 à 500 personnes)

  • Une bonne maîtrise des problématiques d’intégration et de flux de données (API, webhooks, synchronisation)

  • Une capacité à comprendre, challenger et structurer un écosystème d’outils dans sa globalité

  • Une expérience avec des outils d’automatisation (Make, Zapier, n8n ou équivalent)

  • Une expérience en management d’équipe technique

  • Une capacité à travailler de manière transverse avec des interlocuteurs métiers variés

Ce poste n’est pas adapté si

  • tu es très orienté(e) grands groupes avec des SI lourds et peu agiles

  • tu recherches un rôle purement stratégique sans implication opérationnelle

  • ton expertise est principalement orientée sécurité (ce périmètre est couvert par un autre rôle)

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Une entreprise SaaS solide avec des fondamentaux rares, qui combine croissance soutenue et rentabilité

  • Tu arrives à un moment clé où beaucoup reste à structurer pour passer un cap, avec déjà une base existante

  • Une proximité avec la direction, un bon niveau d’autonomie et des cycles de décision rapides

  • Un rôle avec un impact visible rapidement, aussi bien sur les équipes que sur les résultats

  • Des sujets variés et concrets, entre structuration du SI et montée en gamme

  • Une équipe accessible, impliquée et orientée résultats

Poste basé à Montagnat (01) avec présence attendue 2 jours par semaine.

  • Suivi et pilotage d’un portefeuille de clients existants, en majorité des PME, avec une approche personnalisée selon leurs enjeux et leur maturité.

  • Suivi régulier des performances et définition d’actions pour maximiser la valeur créée pour chaque client.

Développement du chiffre d’affaires

  • Détection et qualification d’opportunités d’upsell et de cross-sell, dans une logique de conseil.

  • Préparation et négociation des renouvellements de contrats.

Travail en collaboration transverse

  • Coordination avec les équipes internes (Produit, Tech, Support, Marketing) pour faire remonter les besoins clients, fluidifier les projets en cours et contribuer à l’amélioration continue de nos offres.

  • Tu disposes d’une expérience significative en gestion de comptes B2B, idéalement dans un environnement digital ou technologique.

  • Tu es orienté(e) résultats, avec le sens des priorités et de la rigueur dans le suivi.

  • Tu es à l’aise pour travailler avec des interlocuteurs variés, notamment au sein de structures PME où les décisions se prennent vite mais nécessitent finesse et crédibilité.

  • Tu fais preuve d’autonomie, proactivité et envie de contribuer activement à la croissance d’une entreprise en plein développement.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • L'opportunité de rejoindre une entreprise en pleine croissance et de jouer un rôle clé dans son expansion vers de nouveaux produits et marchés, 

  • Un poste varié avec des projets et des clients différents, puisque nous accompagnons des entreprises de toutes tailles et secteurs, 

  • Un rôle à fort impact : tu contribues directement à simplifier les dépenses professionnelles de nos clients, à leur apporter une vraie valeur au quotidien et à veiller à leur satisfaction,

  • Et bien sûr, une équipe dynamique avec une ambiance start up.

Un package global de l’ordre de 36 à 70 K€ est composé :

  • D’une rémunération fixe,

  • D’une rémunération variable déplafonnée

Vous bénéficierez également :

  • De la possibilité d’avoir une voiture de fonction,

  • D’un smartphone et ordinateur portable,

  • Du statut cadre, mutuelle, RTT,

  • Et surtout d’un environnement de travail bienveillant et motivant.

Peu de déplacements client. Présence sur notre site de Montagnat (01) 2 jours par semaine. CDI. Temps plein. RTT

title: Satcom Consultant Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Novaspace
description_html:
Are you a highly-motivated, technically-minded, critical thinker with 3-5 years of experience in consulting, looking for your next challenge? Join a leading consulting player in the booming space industry!
 
The Technology Consulting business line is the technology and operations’ arm of the Novaspace group. It has more than 50 customers in developed and emerging space markets, in all regions of the world and across the space ecosystem, including satellite operators, governmental and international organizations (Space agencies, Defense agencies, regulatory bodies, etc.), financial institutions (private banks, commercial banks, private equity funds, etc.),insurance brokers and insurance companies.
 
Novaspace Technology has developed expertise and know-how around a portfolio of services and capabilities covering the complete lifecycle of a space project, from feasibility studies and project development to operations and training support.
 
We are looking for motivated consultant satcom engineers to support different consulting missions: technical studies (e.g. State of the art or innovation analysis), feasibility analysis (comparison of several high level designs) and procurement (RFP & comparative analysis of industrial proposals) of different satcom systems (LEO, MEO & GEO).
 
If this sounds like you, then read on!

Who we are looking for
  • You have a good technical knowledge of at least one of the topics mentioned above.
  • You like to learn and improve quickly on technical concepts and actors to grasp the technological and application challenges.
  • You have a real team spirit, and you are rigorous.
  • You can summarize information from a complex report to a short presentation or produce a single intelligible content from multiple sources.
  • You are proficient in writing reports and presentations with a high level of quality.
  • You are a good communicator, able to present content with ease in front of an audience.
  • You are well organized, with a good level of autonomy to perform your tasks in cooperation with your leader (using collaborative and simple project management tools).

    • Primary role and responsibilities
  • Support (and eventually lead) the missions above mentioned which can include data collection and analysis, technical surveys of upcoming technologies and standards, support to system design analysis and generation of technical reports and presentations in accordance with project requirements.
  • Contribute to (and eventually lead) the management of engineering studies (development of the technical and project management documents, determination of the necessary resources, communication with stakeholders, management of contracts). Ensure that they meet technical, programmatic, quality and cost objectives.
  • Participate in writing consulting proposals or technical reports.

    • Desired skills & experience
  • MSc in space engineering with a major preferably in telecommunications (incl. software development will be a plus).
  • 3 to 5 years of experience within the space sector preferably in satcom but could be EO or other.
  • Satellite communications expertise including satellite link budget analysis , and or development of payload architecture is an asset,
  • In addition to strong technical capabilities, you have good presentation and interpersonal skills (soft skills) as the position requires daily collaboration with other Novaspace engineers and international customers.
  • Ability to travel, as you will be able to work at our clients' sites or operations anywhere in the world: Europe, Middle East, Asia, the Americas, etc
  • Fluent in English
  • EU citizen or permanent EU residence/work permit
    • About Novaspace
     
    Novaspace is the global leading consulting firm in the space sector. With a robust 40-year legacy of expertise in guiding private companies and government entities through strategic decisionmaking processes, Novaspace offers end-to-end consulting services, from project strategy definition to implementation, providing data-led perspectives on critical issues. Our mission is to empower clients with strategic and technical insights, enabling them to navigate and seize new opportunities within the rapidly evolving space sector. As a privately owned and fully independent organization, Novaspace presents an expanded portfolio of services, featuring combined expertise in management and technology consulting, top-tier executive summits, and market intelligence. Trusted by 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace has offices strategically located in Brussels, Montreal, Munich, Paris, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington D.C. Working at Novaspace will give you the opportunity to boost your career in the space/consulting industry where our role is to support the decision-makers by providing them the highest quality support in everything we do: consulting, market intelligence, training and summits. 
     
    Only Applications containing a Motivation Letter and a CV in English will be considered.

title: Outbound GTM Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Didomi
description_html:
Didomi helps organizations collect, store, and leverage user choices across multiple channels, increasing precision in marketing and advertising operations and building trust through transparent data practices.

Through a comprehensive software platform and premium support services, Didomi enables large corporations to optimize the collection and activation of user choice data, monitor vendor and tracker activity, and reduce compliance risk under global privacy regulations.

Following the 2025 acquisitions of Addingwell and Sourcepoint, Didomi has strengthened its end-to-end capabilities across consent, preferences, and data activation, bringing together server-side tagging and privacy technology to deliver experiences that improve performance, trust, and loyalty.

Active in 35 countries, Didomi supports over 2,000 clients across various sectors, including some of the world’s largest corporations, in building revenue-driving operations based on reliable and robust user choice data.

For more information, please visit www.didomi.io

The role

We are hiring a Outbound GTM Engineer to design, industrialize and run the engine behind our outbound acquisition. This is an individual contributor role, reporting directly the Revenue Operations Director working closely with the CRO, with a priority mandate to accelerate customer acquisition and expansion at the Group Level across North America and EMEA. You will own the data, the signals, the scoring and the automation that make our outreach sharper, faster and more scientific, and you will feed Sales with the best possible pipeline.

What you'll do

  • Clean and structure our TAM across all markets: deduplication, enrichment and segmentation.

  • Deliver exceptional-quality outreach data that every rep can rely on.

  • Centralize all buying and intent signals, and score every prospect and customer in the base.

  • Accelerate new business, expansion and cross-sell by feeding Sales the best data and intent, with a priority on Addingwell.

  • Automate the full lead workflow end to end: capture, enrichment, deduplication, scoring, routing and sequencing.

  • Improve prospection workflows across the main channels (email, LinkedIn, cold calling).

  • Build and scale a methodical, multichannel outbound machine (ICP, sequences, A/B testing, personalization at scale).

  • Improve inbound lead scoring and reactivate marketing-sourced leads into pipeline.

  • Track performance rigorously and iterate relentlessly on conversion rates.

What we're looking for

  • Outbound track record: you have built an outbound machine from scratch and can quantify its impact (pipeline, ARR, conversion rates).

  • Lead workflow automation: you automate capture, enrichment, scoring, routing and sequencing, and you are comfortable with ops tools, APIs, webhooks and no-code / low-code.

  • Tooling mastery: hands-on with ZoomInfo, lemlist and a modern CRM.

  • Data and signal mindset: you turn intent signals into prioritized, high-quality lists.

  • Copywriting and sequencing: messaging that converts, tested at scale.

  • International reach: fluent English and the ability to operate across North America and EMEA.

  • A scientific, automation-first operator: systematic, analytical, resilient, and fully accountable for your numbers.

Nice to have

  • Experience in adtech / martech, or around server-side tagging (Addingwell relevance).

  • Familiarity with privacy and consent (Didomi relevance).

Tools you'll use

ZoomInfo, Clay, Lemlist and Salesforce, alongside the enrichment and automation stack you will help shape.

title: Channel Account Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Watchguard
description_html:
This is a field position. 

About the Position

The Channel Account Manager (CAM) responsibilities include working within the sales team to promote and sell network security products within a geographic territory. The CAM is responsible for supporting assigned WatchGuard partners in the assigned territory and will be responsible for active channel partners. The CAM will be responsible for quoting, training, lead generation and follow-up, event support, and the forecasting and tracking for their assigned partners. The CAM will report to the Country Manager, working closely to assure territory quota attainment, in addition to joining with the sales and field marketing teams in the territory. Success in this position will be measured by meeting successful transaction, growth, and retention goals with the assigned partners. The CAM will keep up-to-date knowledge of the industry and the competitive posture of the company, as well as prepare activity and forecast reports as requested.


Position Responsibilities

· Strive towards the territory quota attainment, retention, and growth/development of active partners

· Maintain regular contact with partners to ensure satisfaction and continued success

· Partner with Territory Channel Account Manager to generate new business and develop current customers through the partner network

· Support partners on standard methodologies and use of WatchGuard, including training, event support, and lead generation

· Create and perform sales presentations to match WatchGuard with audience needs

· Provide ongoing relationship management and training for partners

· Net growth for WatchGuard One Certifications in the territory

· Be knowledgeable of all WatchGuard products, services, and internal sales tools

· Other duties and projects assigned


Skills and Qualifications

· Experience with two-tier/channel sales ecosystem required

· Experience in network/cyber security space preferred

· History of sales experience with partner accounts

· History of consistent plan development and quota achievement

· Strong presentation and written skills

· Ability to self-manage and work remotely

· Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM


Experience

· 2+ years’ experience in direct and indirect sales in related industry

· Bachelor’s degree or equivalent training in business, sales, or marketing.


Why Work for WatchGuard?

WatchGuard is a global leader in network security and intelligence, advanced endpoint protection, multi-factor authentication, and secure Wi-Fi. Our award-winning products and services are trusted worldwide by more than 18,000 security resellers and service providers to protect more than 250,000 customers. Our technology keeps our customers ahead of increasingly sophisticated hackers and has fueled record revenues at WatchGuard.

WatchGuard is headquartered in Seattle, Washington, with team members working remotely and in offices worldwide.

Our company culture places an intense focus on our customers and employees. From the newest employee to our CEO, you'll find that each person at WatchGuard embodies our Core Values:

Accountability, Community, Belonging, Action, Innovation, and Customer-Centric. Learn more about our company culture at www.watchguard.com/wgrd-careers.

WatchGuard provides equal employment opportunities for all qualified employees, regardless of their race, color, national origin, religion, ancestry, creed, pregnancy, age, sex, sexual orientation (including gender expression or identity), marital status, mental or physical disability, honorably discharged veteran or military status or any other category protected by federal, state or local laws. Our equal employment opportunity (or EEO) policy focuses solely on the talent, hard work, contributions, and actual results achieved by each WatchGuard employee and on the potential of employment candidates to make such contributions. We consider focusing on an employee's protected characteristics rather than on talent, hard work, and actual work results to violate our EEO policy. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we are committed to a diverse workforce. WatchGuard participates in E-verify.

WatchGuard is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

You will work cross-functionally on a regular basis, partnering with teams such as Legal and Security to get responses reviewed and signed off.     • Platform & User Administration – Administer user access and permissions within Ombud, Pigment's RFP tooling, keeping the platform running smoothly for the wider GTM team and becoming a go-to resource for basic platform questions.

    • Status Tracking – Keep RFP trackers and dashboards current so that the GTM Org and leadership always have visibility into RFP performance.

      • Infosec Questionnaire Support

      • Technical SC Partnership – Work closely with the Technical Solution Consulting team to respond to Infosec questionnaires, coordinating inputs and ensuring responses are submitted accurately and on time.

      • Question Routing – Triage incoming Infosec questions, handling standard items directly from the answer library and routing anything technical to the Technical SC team.

        • Demo Automation Platform Administration (Consensus)

        • User Administration – Manage user access and permissions within Consensus, Pigment's demo automation platform.

        • Content Administration – Organise, tag, and maintain content within Consensus so that demo videos and Interactive Product Tours stay current and easy for the field to find.

          • Content Creation & Video Editing (Descript)

          • Content Support – Support the creation of demo videos and other digital content, using Descript to edit and produce assets for the Video demo library.

            • Cross-Functional Coordination

            • GTM Partnership – Act as a responsive point of contact for AEs on RFP status, timelines, and next steps.

            • Legal & Security Coordination – Work cross-functionally with teams such as Legal and Security to route questions, gather input, and get RFP and Infosec responses reviewed and signed off.

            • CSM Coordination – Support Post-Sales teams with the administrative steps of security and infosec review requests, routing them to the right owner.


    Who You Are:

    • Experience: Entry level or early career (1-3 years).  Some experience in the software industry or operational experience in an industry setting would be an advantage. No prior presales experience required.

    • Location & Language: Based in our Paris office, with fluency in English required.

    • Organised & Detail-Oriented: Comfortable managing multiple requests at once, with a strong eye for accuracy and consistency in written material.  You must be able to work under pressure and manage tight deadlines.

    • Proactive Communicator: Openly communicates status, roadblocks, and concerns with the SIC team and stakeholders across GTM.

    • Coachable: Takes ownership of individual learning, asks questions, and seeks support on assigned tasks as they ramp.

    • AI-Proficient: Comfortable using AI tools to automate process workflows and improve day-to-day efficiency, and keen to keep exploring new ways AI can streamline operational work.

    • Collaborative: Works well within the SIC team and with outside teams (AEs, Post-Sales, Legal, Security, Product) when called upon.

In this role, you will be responsible for preparing and painting aircraft surfaces to meet high industry standards. Your expertise in surface preparation, painting, and finishing will be crucial in ensuring aircraft are ready for operation and maintain their durability in various conditions.

  • Familiarity with corrosion prevention and metal treatment processes.
  • Knowledge of environmentally safe painting products and techniques.
  • Ability to apply complex custom designs, logos, or branding.
  • Certification in aircraft painting or a relevant field (preferred but not mandatory depending on experience).
  • Knowledge of relevant aviation regulatory standards (such as FAA or EASA guidelines) concerning painting and surface finishing.
  • Training in the safe handling of hazardous materials (e.g., OSHA, WHMIS certification).

title: Front End Design Engineer

description_html:
About Seamflow

Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files.

Where we are:

  • Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry

  • $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze.

  • Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists.

The team

Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further.

The role

A Front End Design Engineer thinks in finished interfaces, not mockups or components in isolation. A technical reviewer at a notified body spends their day inside a 400-page technical file, cross-referencing clauses, checking test reports against standards, and deciding whether a medical device is safe to sell. Today they do that in Word, Acrobat and a spreadsheet someone built in 2011. The interface they use decides how fast they work and whether they trust the AI sitting next to them.

You own that interface. Layout, typography, interaction, motion, the design system underneath it, and the React that ships it. You decide how a reviewer sees a finding, how they correct a model that got it wrong, and how a hundred fields of dense regulatory data become something a person can actually read. You sketch it, build it, ship it, then sit next to someone using it and find out what you got wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week.

What we're looking for

We care far more about taste and engineering strength than about matching a list of tools. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in React, Svelte, Vue or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, craft and speed are not.

What we're actually screening for:

  • You've designed and built an interface that real people used every day. Not a Dribbble shot, not a component library nobody adopted. Something that shipped, got used, and got better.

  • You have taste, and you can defend it. Typography, spacing, motion, hierarchy. You notice when something is a few pixels off and you can explain why it matters.

  • You build the whole thing. Design, frontend, the state and data it sits on. You don't hand the code to someone else once the Figma is done, and you don't hand the design to someone else once the code is.

  • You can design for density. Expert users, complex workflows, hundreds of fields on a screen. Making that clear is much harder than making a landing page beautiful.

  • You go to the source. You'll watch a technical reviewer work through a real file, and you'll design for what they actually do rather than what the process diagram says.

Signals we like, none of them required:

design engineering or front-end roles at somewhere like Linear, Vercel, Notion or Figma, a design system you built and maintained, work on interfaces where people review or correct AI output, founder or ex-founder, founding team experience, EF / YC / Antler, early or stealth-stage startup.

This is probably not for you if

  • You want a strict boundary between work and life. We run one of the most ambitious startup cultures in Europe: fast paced, extremely high ownership, and in person in Shoreditch.

  • You want a well-defined ticket handed to you each morning.

  • You want to specialise narrowly and stay in your lane.

What you get

  • Real equity, and compensation that reflects a high bar

  • Genuine ownership of product surface area from day one, with the founders in the room

  • Relocation support and visa sponsorship, handled properly

  • Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access, and any tool that makes you faster

  • A small team with high standards, high trust, and no politics

If this sounds like your kind of problem, apply. A short note on the hardest thing you've built goes further with us than a polished CV.

description_html:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

🚀 The Role

We’re hiring a Senior GTM Manager to join the Buy Engine.

tem predominantly sells through a partner network to SME businesses, and this role owns partner activation from systems to story. You’ll build the automation layer that makes the programme scalable, run the events and community engine that builds trust in market, drive the ABM plays that generate targeted pipeline, and translate tem’s product complexity into narratives partners and buy-side clients actually use. The metric you move is new pipeline generated.

The job requires two gears running in parallel. You ship fast, drawing on experience rather than waiting for a brief. And you zoom out regularly to build the systems that mean the next quarter is easier than this one.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Ship the agentic workflows that take the manual drag out of events, partner comms, and product marketing.

  • Build our events programme into a system that enables more in-person and community engagement across the UK and abroad.

  • Run ABM plays that generate new pipeline, with clear leading metrics helping you iterate quickly.

  • Turn tem’s most complex product and pricing innovation into positioning partners can sell.

  • Develop the automated product launch workflow, from PM spec through to go-to-market brief.

🛠️ Responsibilities

  • Build and automate: design and ship the agentic workflows that remove manual drag from events, partner comms, and product marketing, and keep building the GTM automation stack as the programme grows.

  • Run partner activation: own the events programme end to end, drive stickiness and engagement on our core activation channels, and run GTM experiments inside tem’s fortnightly sprint rhythm, compounding the playbook sprint by sprint.

  • Translate complexity into narrative: turn the hardest parts of energy into positioning partners can sell and customers are persuaded by, and keep the market story consistent and specific.

  • Own the intelligence loop: turn customer insights into structured signals that actively challenge and improve our positioning and GTM priorities, and own competitive intelligence on our key GTM bets.

  • Measure what matters: track what each activation play costs in time and money and what it returns in pipeline, own the reporting inside the fortnightly rhythm, and build the institutional memory that means the engine doesn’t reset when people join or leave.

✅ Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Builder orientation: you ship fast, draw on experience, and don’t need a fully formed brief to move.

  • Systems thinking in parallel: you can zoom out from daily execution to build the infrastructure that scales the programme, and do both at once.

  • Marketing literacy across the full GTM stack: positioning, narrative, activation, and channel strategy.

  • Hands-on, daily use of AI or no-code tools, with evidence you’ve built real workflows rather than one-off experiments.

  • B2B or B2B2C channel experience: you’ve marketed through or to a partner network, not just direct.

  • Comfortable operating at pace in a Series B environment where the playbook is being written as you go and the standards matter.

Desirable

  • Experience owning or contributing to an ABM programme.

  • Community or events programme ownership.

  • Exposure to complex or regulated industries where product narrative is genuinely hard, such as energy, fintech, infrastructure, or healthcare.

🎁 Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to £1,200 or €1,200 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to £150 or €150 per month for wellbeing.

🤝 Interview Process

We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. If you need us to adapt anything, let us know.

  • First call with our Talent Team.

  • Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager.

  • Technical Interview with the Team (90 mins). You’ll meet with potential peers in this session and will discuss your approach to GTM systems design and partner activation.

  • Bar Raiser Interview with Stakeholders.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

title: Customer Success Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Accurx
description_html:
Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

That sounds cool — what does a Customer Success Manager have to do with it?

Accurx works with 41 of the 42 NHS ICBs in primary care and is growing fast in secondary care. The relationships that make that possible — the trust, the renewals, the accounts that stay with us even when competitors come knocking on price — are owned by our Customer Success team.

We’re hiring three CSMs to grow the team across both primary and secondary care. You’ll own a portfolio of enterprise NHS accounts end-to-end, from implementation through to renewal. In primary care, it’s about protecting and deepening relationships that are already strong. In secondary care, it’s about building them from scratch in a market where Accurx Scribe is winning big and growing fast. Either way, it’s about being the person NHS organisations trust — the one who knows their priorities, anticipates problems before they arise, and makes Accurx genuinely indispensable.

The challenges you’ll solve as a Customer Success Manager

  • Own your NHS accounts end-to-end. You’ll manage a portfolio of 5–11 ICB or Trust enterprise accounts — building relationships, driving adoption, leading renewals, and keeping Accurx sticky even when the NHS is in flux. You’re the person your customers call first.

  • Build trust where Accurx is new. In secondary care, we’re expanding quickly into a more complex environment. You’ll help NHS Trusts get real outcomes from Accurx Scribe — building processes that don’t yet exist and earning the kind of trust we’ve spent years building in primary care.

  • Be a connector, not just an account manager. You’ll work across marketing, implementation, transformation, commercial ops, and finance. The best CSMs here don’t just manage accounts — they bring the voice of the customer back into the business and make things better for the whole team.

  • Build the playbook as you go. The team is scaling and many of our processes are still being written. You’ll contribute to and shape how account management works at Accurx. What works gets codified; what doesn’t gets challenged.

  • Navigate the NHS with patience and precision. NHS organisations are under enormous pressure — restructuring, funding uncertainty, stakeholder churn. You’ll hold relationships through difficult periods and keep Accurx front of mind even when it’s not their immediate priority.

You should apply if...

  • You own relationships, not just accounts. You’ve worked in customer success, account management, or a relationship-heavy role and you know the difference between being a yes-person and being a trusted advisor. Accurx has no commission plan — success here is measured by trust, retention, and real outcomes.

  • You push back constructively. You don’t jump when a customer says jump. You ask why — more than once — and you find a better solution. You’re empathetic but not a pushover.

  • You’re comfortable building from scratch. Processes aren’t fully defined here. You’d rather create structure than wait for someone else to do it, and you’re okay if the first version isn’t perfect.

  • You’re curious about the NHS. Whether you’ve worked in or around it or you’re coming in fresh — you’re genuinely interested in how it works and patient enough to navigate its complexity.

  • You’re AI-native. You use AI tools to work smarter — automating the routine so you can spend more time on the things that actually need you.

  • You’re a natural connector. You’re as comfortable in a room with a clinical lead as you are with a Trust’s Head of Digital Transformation or a commercial director. You adapt your style and bring people with you.

What’s in it for me?

You’ll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we’re led by our Principles and our mission to Solve Healthcare Productivity.

  • £50,000 – £70,000 salary + share options up to £15,000

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Flexible Working: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am–4pm

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Family matters: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own Chef! Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches will be provided, with the occasional sweet treat!

Want to know more about the company or the hiring process? Check out our Careers page and Candidate hub.

Find us across social media: Medium, LinkedIn, X, Instagram and YouTube.

Diversity and Equal Opportunities: We are an equal opportunities employer and a pleasant and supportive place to work. We particularly welcome applications from those who are significantly underrepresented in the technology sector, such as women, non-binary people, transgender people, people with disabilities, LGBTQIA+ community and individuals from Black and Minority Ethnic communities.

Compensation: £50K – £70K • Offers Equity

title: IT Service Koordinator / Kundenbetreuer (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at OESTMANN GmbH
description_html:
Wir suchen einen engagierten IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d), der unser dynamisches Team verstärkt und mit Begeisterung die IT-Infrastruktur unserer Kunden weiter entwickelt.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgabe bei uns

Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und unserem Technik-Team.

Wenn ein Kunde eine Störung meldet, Unterstützung benötigt oder einen neuen Auftrag erteilt, sorgst Du dafür, dass das Thema strukturiert aufgenommen, priorisiert und an den richtigen Techniker weitergegeben wird.

Dabei behältst Du offene Vorgänge im Blick und stellst sicher, dass unsere Kunden zuverlässig informiert und betreut werden.

Dein Ziel: Der Kunde weiß, dass wir uns kümmern – und unsere Techniker wissen, was wann zu tun ist.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Annahme und Koordination von Kundenanfragen, Störungen und Aufträgen
  • Persönliche und telefonische Betreuung unserer Bestandskunden
  • Erfassen, Priorisieren und Nachverfolgen von Service-Tickets
  • Einschätzung der Dringlichkeit und Priorität von Störungen
  • Koordination und Einsatzplanung unserer IT-Techniker
  • Zuordnung von Aufgaben zum passenden technischen Mitarbeiter
  • Überwachung von offenen Tickets, Terminen und zugesagten Rückmeldungen
  • Aktive Kommunikation mit Kunden über den aktuellen Bearbeitungsstand
  • Erkennen von Eskalationen und rechtzeitiges Gegensteuern
  • Abstimmung zwischen Kunde, Technik, Vertrieb und Backoffice
  • Vorbereitung und Koordination kleinerer IT-Aufträge und Projekte
  • Kontrolle, ob Aufträge und Störungen vollständig abgeschlossen und dokumentiert wurden
  • Unterstützung bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Serviceprozesse

Was uns besonders wichtig ist

Du musst kein tiefgehender IT-Spezialist sein.

Du solltest aber ein gutes technisches Grundverständnis besitzen und einschätzen können, ob beispielsweise ein ausgefallener Server, eine Firewall-Störung oder ein nicht funktionierender Arbeitsplatz unterschiedliche Prioritäten benötigen.

Noch wichtiger sind für uns:

Organisation, Verbindlichkeit, Kommunikation und Eigeninitiative.

Du wartest nicht darauf, dass jemand nach einem Vorgang fragt, sondern behältst selbstständig den Überblick und kümmerst Dich darum, dass Themen weitergehen.

Qualifikation

Das solltest Du mitbringen

  • Freude an Kundenkontakt und Kommunikation
  • Ausgeprägte Service- und Kundenorientierung
  • Sehr gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten
  • Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • Verbindlichkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein
  • Fähigkeit, mehrere Vorgänge gleichzeitig zu koordinieren
  • Ruhe und Übersicht auch bei dringenden Störungen
  • Grundverständnis für IT und technische Zusammenhänge
  • Erfahrung in einem IT-Systemhaus, IT-Support oder technischen Service ist von Vorteil
  • Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen, Helpdesk oder Einsatzplanung ist ebenfalls von Vorteil

Benefits

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten IT-Unternehmen
  • Vielfältige und verantwortungsvolle Aufgabenbereiche
  • Flache Hierarchiestrukturen und effiziente Entscheidungsprozesse
  • Gezielte Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Moderne Arbeitsausstattung und professionelle IT-Infrastruktur
  • Attraktive Vergütung sowie ein engagiertes und professionelles Team

Wer wir sind

Die OESTMANN GmbH ist ein inhabergeführtes IT-Systemhaus aus Hamburg.

Seit über 50 Jahren unterstützen wir Unternehmen bei der Planung, Umsetzung und Betreuung ihrer IT.

Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen unter anderem in den Bereichen IT-Infrastruktur, Server- und Cloud-Lösungen, Microsoft 365, Netzwerk und WLAN, IT-Sicherheit, Firewall, Managed Security, Backup und Recovery sowie persönlichem IT-Support.

Wir verstehen uns nicht nur als IT-Lieferant, sondern als langfristiger IT-Partner unserer Kunden.

Unser Anspruch ist es, Probleme nicht nur zu verwalten, sondern sie aktiv zu lösen und möglichst zu verhindern, bevor sie entstehen.

title: Senior Performance Marketing Executive (B2C)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Octopus Energy Group
description_html:
What we do. Electric Car Leasing

Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future.


Consumer growth at Octopus Electric Vehicles has accelerated quickly over the last two years, and paid media is a huge part of how we reach more drivers and grow the business.

We're looking for a brilliant Senior Performance Marketing Executive to take day-to-day ownership of our paid digital activity - with one big goal: help us get more from every pound we spend.

This is a hands-on role for someone who loves performance marketing at the detail level. You'll be in Google Ads regularly, analysing search terms, adjusting budgets and bids, spotting wasted spend, testing new approaches and working out where we can improve conversion and scale efficiently.

Paid search will be at the heart of the role, and you'll also help us explore and grow channels like Paid Social, Display and Programmatic, testing where they can add incremental value to our existing activity. 

You'll sit within our B2C Growth squad, reporting into the Senior Consumer Growth Marketing Manager, and work closely with our Content Creator, Design, Commercial and wider Marketing teams.

This would suit someone with strong hands-on performance marketing experience, perhaps from an agency or fast-paced in-house environment, who wants more ownership, more visibility and more opportunity to influence what happens next.


What you'll do

  • 🚀 Own our paid media campaigns: Build, manage and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads and Meta, with paid search as your core focus initially.

  • 💰 Make our spend work harder: Identify wasted spend, underperforming campaigns and opportunities to improve efficiency, with clear recommendations on where to push, pause, reduce or reallocate budget.

  • 📈 Optimise towards the outcomes that matter: Look beyond clicks and leads to understand which campaigns and audiences are driving better-quality customers and orders, and use that insight to improve performance.

  • 🖥️ Help us grow Display and Programmatic: Identify opportunities across prospecting and retargeting, shape audiences and creative approaches, launch tests, analyse performance and recommend where there is a genuine opportunity to scale.

  • 📊 Stay close to performance: Monitor spend, pacing and key metrics, spot changes quickly and turn the numbers into clear, practical recommendations.

  • 🧪 Test, learn and improve: Work with our Content Creator and Design team to test messaging, creative, formats, audiences and landing-page approaches.

  • 🎯 Keep campaigns clean and measurable: Make sure tracking, UTMs, audiences, naming conventions and campaign structures are set up properly so we can trust the data we're using to make decisions.

  • 🌐 Help improve what happens after the click: Support campaign landing pages and other digital experiences, including drafting copy and building or updating pages using our web tools when needed.

  • 🤝 Make campaigns happen: Coordinate briefs, creative, links, tracking and launches across the team so activity gets live quickly.


What you'll need

Strong hands-on paid search experience. You're confident building, managing and optimising Google Ads campaigns yourself, from search terms and match types to bidding, budgets and campaign structure.

A proper performance mindset. You naturally look at an account and ask: Where are we wasting money? What could perform better? What should we test next?

Good commercial judgement. You know the cheapest click or lead isn't always the best one, and you're interested in what actually drives better-quality customers and orders.

Confidence managing paid media budgets. You're comfortable keeping an eye on pacing, spotting where performance is changing and recommending where spend should move.

Experience with Display or Programmatic. Ideally, you've worked hands-on with Display campaigns, DV360, Campaign Manager 360 or similar platforms. You don't need to be a programmatic specialist, but you should understand the basics and be excited to help us grow this area.

Some paid social experience. Experience with Meta Ads Manager or other paid social platforms would be useful.

You're comfortable with the technical detail. You understand why conversion tracking, UTMs, audiences, naming conventions and clean campaign setup matter, and you're happy digging into data to work out what's going on.

Around 2-4 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, ideally in an agency, media business or fast-paced in-house environment. We're flexible on exact years - what matters most is your technical ability, curiosity and attitude.

Most importantly, you enjoy doing the work. You like being in-platform, finding opportunities and making things better, and you're proactive, commercially minded, low-ego and great to work with. Things move quickly here, priorities change and everyone pitches in, so you'll thrive if you're happy getting stuck in, helping others and figuring things out as you go.


Why else you'll love it here
  • 💰 Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!

  • 🎉 Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! 🎁 Visit our perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits

  • 🏆 Octopus Electric Vehicles, part of the Octopus Energy Group, won the Sunday Times best company to work for in 2024. We were named 6th out of the top 100 start-ups to work for by Tempo in 2025 and on Glassdoor we were voted 50 best places to work in 2022. Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership

    • Things to note
  • 🐶 just to let you know, we are dog friendly company so you may see our 4 legged friends in the offices - feel free to bring yours! Rest assured though, we've taken lots of precautions for those who have allergies

  • 🤖 We use AI to help us assess applications fairly and objectively. We’re totally fine with you using AI as a tool to help prepare too. That said, when we get to the interview and assessment stage, we’re really interested in hearing your unique perspective and real-world stories. That’s the stuff we can’t get from a bot or a prompt!

    • About us
     
    The electric revolution has arrived - and from 2035 you’ll no longer be able to buy a new petrol or diesel car in the UK. 
     
    We’re building a whole new way for drivers to join the electric charge and not only learn about and shop for their EV online, but experience a 'lease for life' through an industry changing customer experience. This is the chance to join one of the UK’s most exciting start-ups – making it easy for individuals and businesses to go electric by getting their car, charger and energy all in one cracking deal.
     
    Octopus Electric Vehicles launched in 2018 to make it seamless to switch to cleaner, greener driving. Our mission is to drive sustainable change, decarbonise the planet and provide our customers with fair pricing and a fantastic experience. 
     
    We're an Octopus Energy company—an innovative new energy supplier. We are part of the Octopus Energy Group, which seeks to improve the lives of millions of people by transforming the industries we operate in. The Octopus Group incorporates Octopus Energy, Octopus Healthcare, Octopus Investments, Octopus Property, Octopus Ventures and Octopus Labs.
     

    If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you.

    Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic!

    Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. Across Octopus, we're looking for genuinely decent people who are honest and empathetic. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities, an inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone.
