description_html:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Tether is seeking a Blockchain Expansion Manager to drive strategic growth initiatives across Tether’s blockchain partner ecosystem. This role sits within the Blockchain Expansion function and focuses on building and managing high-impact relationships with blockchain foundations while executing strategic projects that expand the real-world adoption and utility of Tether assets.

The Blockchain Expansion Manager will work closely with blockchain partners to design and deliver initiatives that meaningfully grow Tether’s asset usage through practical, real-world use cases. This role requires strong partnership management skills, strategic thinking, and the ability to execute complex projects across multiple internal and external stakeholders.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, operates with autonomy, and brings structure and rigor to high-impact growth initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and deepen strategic relationships with blockchain foundations and ecosystem partners.
    Act as the primary point of contact for assigned blockchain partners, ensuring alignment between partner objectives and Tether’s strategic priorities.

  • Design and execute high-impact growth projects in collaboration with blockchain partners to drive adoption of Tether assets through real-world use cases.

  • Think strategically about how Tether can work with blockchain ecosystems to create scalable, sustainable projects that expand asset usage and circulation.

  • Coordinate and manage cross-functional initiatives involving regional expansion, economics, marketing, and other internal teams.

  • Track, manage, and report on project progress, outcomes, and effectiveness, ensuring initiatives deliver against defined objectives.

  • Identify opportunities to improve execution efficiency, project structure, and partner outcomes.

  • Operate with a high degree of autonomy, taking initiative to identify new opportunities and drive them forward.

  • Support internal leadership with clear updates, insights, and recommendations based on partner and project performance.


Mandatory

  • Proven experience in partnership or ecosystem management, ideally within crypto, fintech, or technology.

  • Strong track record of managing high-impact, strategic growth projects from concept through execution.

  • Excellent organisational skills with a high level of attention to detail.

  • Ability to track, manage, and optimise multiple initiatives simultaneously.

  • Strong strategic thinking skills with the ability to translate ideas into executable projects.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as expansion, economics, marketing, or product.

  • Ability to work autonomously, take initiative, and operate effectively in a remote, global environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience working with blockchain foundations or Layer 1 / Layer 2 ecosystems.

  • Familiarity with stablecoins, blockchain infrastructure, or real-world blockchain use cases.

  • Experience operating in fast-growing or unstructured environments.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

description_html:
Waracle are looking for a Senior Mobile Security Developer (Inside IR35) for an exciting new 6-month initial contract joining our world-class digital technology consultancy, home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a UK-based Inside IR35 Contract role, offering the flexibility to balance your professional and personal life, with 2 days a week spent connecting with colleagues in our London office or on client site.


The Role

As a Senior Mobile Security Developer, you will define squad-level technical architecture and technical approach. You are a technical expert who ensures quality, security, and compliance across projects, driving robust and scalable solutions.

This role will be pivotal in building, delivering, and driving the security of our mobile platform, while being an integral part of our full-stack mobile practice, contributing to end-to-end development and security excellence across both front-end and back-end mobile systems.

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Design and Delivery of a World-Class Security Framework: Lead the design and delivery of security services, including mobile penetration testing, research, consultancy, and advisory engagements.

  • Technical Strategy & Architecture: Define secure technical approaches, identify risks, and develop effective threat models and mitigation strategies.

  • Strategic Planning: Translate business objectives into technical strategy and ensure technical roadmaps align with long-term client goals.

  • Agile Practices: Expertise in Agile methodologies, with a focus on resolving impediments and driving adoption across teams.

  • Client Engagement: Communicate effectively with clients, manage expectations, and provide practical, risk-based security recommendations.

  • Continuous Improvement & Collaboration: Drive innovation, adopt emerging security practices, share knowledge, and support team success.


What you'll bring:

We are seeking a highly technical expert with a strong focus on mobile platform security. You should bring:

  • Mobile Security Expertise: Strong hands-on knowledge of Android and iOS security fundamentals, common mobile threats and vulnerabilities, security architecture, controls, and mitigation techniques.

  • Mobile Security Testing: Practical experience in mobile penetration testing, security assessments, threat modelling, and implementing or assessing security controls.

  • Security Problem Solving: A systematic and analytical approach to identifying, investigating, and resolving mobile security issues.

  • Authentication & Cryptography: Strong understanding of authentication, authorisation, cryptography, encryption, and secure design principles, with the ability to recommend appropriate cryptographic controls.

  • Continuous Improvement: A proactive approach to improving security practices, tooling, controls, and ways of working.

Desirable knowledge & experience:

  • Mobile Security Tooling & Analysis: Experience with reverse engineering, analysis techniques, and tools such as Burp Suite Pro, Frida, Objection, JADX, IDA Pro, Hopper, Radare, ADB, Apktool, YARA, Xcode, and Android Studio.

  • Mobile Development & DevSecOps: Knowledge of Android/iOS development, secure development practices, DevSecOps tooling, testing, and automation frameworks.

  • Development & Reverse Engineering: Familiarity with C, Java, Kotlin, Objective-C, Swift, JavaScript, Python or Bash, and ideally ARM/ARM64 assembly.

  • Security Research: Awareness of emerging security technologies, Cloud security, and developments in mobile operating systems, APIs, tools, and security libraries.

What to expect from our hiring process

  • 1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

  • 2. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. Depending on the role, this will be a focused take-home task (capped at 2–3 hours to respect your time) or a practical presentation.

  • 3. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: Langfuse - Senior Product Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Clickhouse
description_html:
Why Product Engineering at Langfuse

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Everything you build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible. Langfuse has 21,900+ GitHub stars and our SDKs are downloaded 23M+ times per month. When you ship a new feature the community notices in GitHub issues, on X, and in our community channels.

Product engineers at Langfuse are the people who deliver new features end-to-end to our users. You own the product thinking from understanding the user problem to deciding what to build to shipping the solution.

You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM applications are built. The users you serve are some of the best and most ambitious software engineers leveraging Langfuse to improve their applications. Deeply understanding the problems they solve will help you design the best possible product and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

 

You will grow at Langfuse by

  • Own features end-to-end: from talking to users, to writing the spec, to shipping the code and docs, to writing the changelog post with your name on it. To give you a sense: recent features a single engineer owned include the Langfuse for Agents release (new trace views, agent graphs, semantic span labels), the TypeScript SDK v4 rewrite on OpenTelemetry, and the hosted MCP server for prompt management.

  • Work across the full stack: and we mean full. Our surface area is wide: React frontend, Next.js backend, ClickHouse analytics, Python and TypeScript SDKs, public docs, Terraform modules, and more. You'll touch whatever the feature needs. One week you might be writing a new ClickHouse query for cost analytics, the next you're designing an SDK API, the next you're building a new React view for agent traces.

  • Talk to users constantly: jump on calls, respond in community channels, and route support requests. At Langfuse, support is how we build conviction about what to build next. Our handbook says it best: support by engineers is a core value proposition.

  • Write public documentation about the features you own. At Langfuse, docs are product.

  • Ship publicly during Launch Weeks: we've run four Launch Weeks so far, dropping a new feature every day for a week. Engineers present the features they built to the community.

 

What we’re looking for

  • Someone who has built features or even entire products from scratch end-to-end

  • Experience building and shipping user-facing products end-to-end, ideally in TypeScript/React and with exposure to data-intensive backends

  • Someone who can manage projects themselves. You know how to develop strong conviction about what to build and how to ship it.

  • Taste for great developer experience: you care about API design, UI details, and clear documentation

  • Interest in open source software and genuine excitement about talking to developers about their problems

  • Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

  • CS or quantitative degree preferred

Bonus points:

  • Experience with ClickHouse, analytics databases, or building complex data visualizations

  • Former founder or early startup experience

  • Contributions to popular open source projects

  • ML/AI background or familiarity with the LLM framework ecosystem

No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply.

 

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

Why Cloud Infrastructure at Langfuse

Your work will keep Langfuse running — everywhere.

Langfuse processes over a billion trace events per month. When a Fortune 50 company relies on Langfuse in production, they're relying on the infrastructure you operate. You'll own uptime, performance, and cost efficiency across our entire cloud footprint — and you'll make sure every self-hosted deployment runs just as smoothly.

You'll operate Langfuse Cloud on AWS ECS Fargate and ClickHouse Cloud, with Datadog as the observability backbone. You'll also own our public self-hosted infrastructure — including our Helm chart, Docker Compose setup, and everything in between — so that teams from startups to enterprises can run Langfuse on their own terms.

This isn't a "maintain what exists" role. We're scaling fast, and you'll be the person who makes sure the infrastructure grows ahead of demand — not behind it.

Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the team behind the database at the core of our stack is one channel away. Few infrastructure roles give you that kind of direct access to the people who build your most critical dependency.

 

You will grow at Langfuse by

Own Langfuse Cloud operations: You'll run our production environments on AWS ECS Fargate and ClickHouse Cloud. You'll manage deployments, autoscaling, capacity planning, and cost optimization — making sure we stay fast and affordable as traffic scales.

Build world-class observability: You'll own our Datadog setup end to end — dashboards, alerts, and SLOs. When something degrades, you'll ensure we know before our customers do. You'll build the monitoring culture that lets the whole team ship with confidence.

Make self-hosting effortless: Thousands of teams run Langfuse on their own infrastructure. You'll own and evolve our Helm chart, Docker Compose configuration, and deployment documentation. You'll turn "works on my machine" into "works on every machine" — from a single-node setup to a multi-region enterprise deployment.

Automate everything: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, automated scaling, zero-downtime deployments. You'll replace manual processes with automation that makes the team faster and the platform more reliable.

Scale for what's next: We're growing fast and new product directions — like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation — push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale and building the foundation before we get there. 10x is always just one quarter away here at Langfuse.

Harden security and compliance: As more enterprises adopt Langfuse, you'll help ensure our cloud and self-hosted deployments meet the security and compliance bar that large organizations require.

title: Langfuse - Senior Backend Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Clickhouse
description_html:
Why Backend Engineering at Langfuse

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Langfuse ingests terabytes of AI tracing data per day. When a Fortune 50 company instruments their application with Langfuse, they hit the infrastructure you built. Everything you ship is open source and immediately visible.

The core of your role is making Langfuse fast and affordable at scale: owning the ingestion pipeline, optimizing ClickHouse data models and queries so dashboards load instantly, and building the backend abstractions that let product engineers ship data-heavy features without reinventing the plumbing each time.

You will also make sure Langfuse runs everywhere. You’ll operate Langfuse Cloud across multiple production environments, and make self-hosting effortless. You will support a single Docker Compose setup to enterprise-grade Helm chart deployment.

 

You won’t be solving these problems alone. Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the people who built the database you’re optimizing are one channel away. Few backend roles give you that kind of access to the internals of your core datastore.

 

You will grow at Langfuse by

  • Own and optimize our ingestion pipeline: Langfuse ingests massive volumes of tracing data through a pipeline that flows from our API to ClickHouse. You'll work on throughput, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency at every stage of this pipeline.

  • Make ClickHouse fast: our tracing data lives in ClickHouse. You'll design schemas, optimize merge strategies, tune batch inserts, write and review analytical queries that power dashboards and the UI. You'll become an expert on ClickHouse internals — and you'll have the ClickHouse database engineering team one channel away.

  • Build new infrastructure-heavy features: things like LLM-as-a-Judge (where we post-process large volumes of ingested data asynchronously), alerting at scale, client-code execution, or batch dataset operations. Build the foundation and, if you like, dip your toes into the frontend for those.

  • Test with real data in production: when evaluating a new ClickHouse schema, migration, or query optimization, you'll run load tests against production data to validate that changes actually improve things. We don't guess at performance. We prototype new table designs, run them in parallel on real traffic, and compare before committing.

  • Scale for what's next: we're growing fast and new product directions like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale.

 

Learn more about our infrastructure

  • From Zero to Scale: Langfuse's Infrastructure Evolution — deep dive into how we went from Postgres to ClickHouse

  • Max talking infrastructure at ClickHouse OpenHouse Amsterdam — recording of our CTO walking through the architecture

  • Architecture

 

What we're looking for

  • Strong backend engineer who gets excited about database internals, query optimization, and distributed systems

  • You get excited when working with a ton of data

  • Experience with analytical databases, data pipelines, or high-throughput event processing. ClickHouse experience is a big plus but not required

  • You organize yourself. You have strong opinions about what to build and how to ship it

  • Comfortable reading and writing TypeScript (our backend) and SQL

  • Interest in open source software and genuine enjoyment talking to users about their scaling challenges

  • Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

  • CS or quantitative degree preferred

 

Bonus points:

 

  • Experience with ClickHouse, other OLAP databases, or observability infrastructure

  • Former founder

  • Background in building data-intensive systems at scale

 

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Location and travel

You can be based in Europe; we're mainly remote and invite you to the Berlin office 3-5 days every two months.

We expect significant travel across the Europe, with occasional travel to other regions when the audience quality justifies it. The exact cadence will change with the event calendar, but you should expect travel to be a meaningful part of the job.

 

Why this role?

Langfuse has grown mostly through product-led, open-source adoption. We built a strong product, wrote useful docs and examples, stayed close to users, shipped in public, and helped developers understand how to build better AI applications.

However, many of the highest-signal moments happen in person: hallway conversations, workshops, meetups, dinners, conference demos, and technical talks.

We want someone who can own that motion end to end; put Langfuse in the right AI engineering rooms, make the product clear to technical audiences, and turn in-person conversations into durable marketing momentum.

The goal is not to do every event. The goal is to make the right events excellent, scalable, and measurable.

 

What you'll do

  • Represent Langfuse at conferences, meetups, workshops, customer events, partner events, and community gatherings across Europe

  • Organize Langfuse-hosted meetups, workshops, dinners, and smaller technical gatherings around the highest-quality audiences.

  • Partner with ClickHouse field marketing, sales, solutions, product marketing, and engineering teams where it helps Langfuse show up well.

  • Turn event learnings into useful artifacts: better messaging, better demos, better docs, better talks, better customer stories, and sharper product feedback.

 

What we're looking for

  • You already create technical content, demos, videos, talks, open source projects, or educational material.

  • You should be excited to travel, give talks, run demos, host events, talk to developers and technical leaders, and bring what you learn back into the company.

title: Working Student / Thesis - Strategy Operations & Business Development (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Tactiliarobotics
description_html:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the team, culture and processes that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when a strong product turns into a real business: how do we build the strategy, the partner and customer pipeline, and the operating rhythm that let us scale as fast as the technology allows?

The Role

As a Working Student or thesis student in Strategy Operations & Business Development, you will work directly with our Business Development lead and on the questions that decide how TACTILIA grows: which markets we go after, how we price and cost what we build, who our first partners and customers are, and how we prove our progress to the board.

Some days you're sizing a market or building a competitor teardown. Other days you're pulling together the numbers for a board update or helping shape a pricing model. Both matter equally here.

What You Will Do

– Support business strategy and market sizing. Help translate our target markets and product priorities into clear numbers – market size, growth, and where the real opportunity sits.

– Track the competitive landscape. Keep tabs on competitors, adjacent players, and relevant funding and product news, and turn it into insights the leadership team can actually use.

– Help build our partner and customer pipeline. Research and qualify potential integrators, partners, and anchor customers, and prepare the materials that support outreach and first conversations.

– Get our office and internal structures off the ground. Help plan and implement our office set-up and the practical structures a growing team needs on the ground – this is a hands-on part of the role, not just an analytical one.

– Help build our internal reporting and steering tools. Contribute to the dashboards and processes that give the leadership team a real-time view of the business.

What You Bring

– Currently studying business administration, industrial engineering, economics, or a related field (Bachelor's or Master's)

– A structured, analytical way of working and genuine comfort with numbers and data

– Real interest in robotics, deep tech, or Physical AI

– Confident with Excel and PowerPoint, and quick to pick up new tools

– Fluent English; German is a plus

– Available for at least four to six months, whether as a working student or for a thesis project

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability, and robustness they need to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape. The team is being built. And the standards for robotic hands and their skills are still wide open.

That means your decisions will have a lasting impact – not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Technical Project Manager (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Berlitz
description_html:
We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning.

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

We're looking for people with software engineering backgrounds who are ready to move into technical project management, owning the business systems work behind our transition from a legacy stack to a new one. These are growth paths, not fully-formed PM seats.

Our legacy stack involves over 100 systems across the globe including proprietary invoicing/billing/scheduling systems, two Salesforce instances and NetSuite, among others. Our new stack is HubSpot, Metronome, Stripe, NetSuite, and Workato. Getting from one to the other — while the business keeps running on both — is the core challenge of both tracks.

We're hiring two people into this role. The skills profile is similar for both, but each hire will own one of two distinct tracks: O2C Integrations or CRM Projects. These tracks will eventually mature into a larger scope of internal tooling and enterprise customization. Track assignment will be based on candidate strengths and interest during onboarding, rather than decided in advance.

Track 1: Order-to-Cash Integrations Projects

Focused on building and connecting

  • Own the Order-to-Cash flow end-to-end — Across both tech stacks. You're accountable for how orders, invoicing, billing, and revenue data move through the business, regardless of which systems they touch.

  • Set integration ecosystem strategy — Define how integrations across business systems should be architected as a whole: point-to-point vs. centralized (e.g., via Workato), reusable patterns, and standards for how new systems connect in.

  • Co-build the Legacy system replacement s— Partner with the Enterprise product team as technical owner of how the new platform's O2C integration layer is architected, including data models and API contracts.

  • Control integration vendors — Own technical evaluation, SLAs, and build-vs-buy decisions for integration tooling and vendors across the ecosystem.

  • Bridge legacy and new-stack engineering teams — Be the technical point of contact ensuring O2C data contracts and dependencies are understood on both sides.

Track 2: CRM & Martech Projects

Focused on retiring and migrating CRM systems

  • Lead the Salesforce 2A sunset project — Own the plan, timeline, and execution for retiring this legacy Salesforce instance, coordinating data migration and cutover with dependent teams.

  • Lead the Salesforce STAR sunset project — Same ownership model, applied to the STAR instance.

  • Control the HubSpot vendor relationship — Own vendor management for HubSpot, including contract terms, SLA performance, and roadmap alignment with vendor capabilities.

  • Own marketing automations — Own the roadmap and execution for marketing automation workflows (built largely on HubSpot). Campaign strategy sits with Marketing; you own the tooling and execution layer those campaigns run on.

  • Manage sunset risk — Identify what breaks if a legacy system goes away too early, and build technically sound mitigation and rollback plans.

What We're Looking For

  • Software engineering background — you've built, maintained, or integrated production systems, ideally including APIs, middleware, or data pipelines.

  • Strong communication skills — able to explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, vendors, and business stakeholders alike.

  • Detail oriented and structured approach — planning and running complex, multi-stakeholder technical projects to completion, including sequencing, risk management, and timeline ownership.

  • Comfortable reading and reasoning about system architecture and data models across multiple connected systems without translation from engineering.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, especially around evolving scope boundaries between adjacent teams during a platform migration.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with billing/invoicing/CRM systems (Salesforce, NetSuite, HubSpot, Stripe, Metronome, Workato, or similar).

  • Experience with vendor management, including contract and SLA negotiation.

  • Background in a company undergoing a legacy-to-modern platform migration.

  • Experience defining integration strategy or standards at an organizational level, not just shipping individual integrations; exposure to integration architecture patterns (point-to-point, iPaaS/middleware, event-driven).

  • Formal project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or similar) — helpful but not required with structured ways of working

Why You Should Join

This is a rare, explicitly structured path out of pure engineering — you're hired as an engineer, judged on engineering judgment, and grow into project management on the job. You'll get unusually broad system exposure fast, which is the kind of company-wide operational map most engineers wait years to see. You will be joining a project management and product operations team and receive ongoing coaching for your career development.

Our global workplace reflects the diverse world we serve, bringing together different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Delivery & Coordination

  • Lead triage for cross-cutting bugs and defects — Own the process for identifying, prioritizing, and assigning ownership of issues that span multiple product areas or teams, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Drive process improvement — Identify recurring delivery bottlenecks or compliance gaps and put in place scalable processes to prevent them.

Platform Delivery (Program)

  • Country-specific requirements — Own the platform-wide program ensuring the platform meets country-specific regulatory and functional requirements (e.g., GDPR and other regional regulations) consistently as we scale globally.

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

title: (Junior) Office Manager f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Applike Group
description_html:
Bring your passion for hospitality and organization to our dynamic Hamburg HQ!

As a (Junior) Office Manager, you will be a daily go-to contact for our 400+ team members. You’ll support our office team across a wide variety of tasks, coordinating room setups, supporting onboarding, stocking supplies, and keeping our spaces in top shape. If you are proactive, speak conversational German and fluent English, and want to build a career in office administration, apply today!

The applike group is committed to creating engaging experiences for every app user around the world. We are passionate about creating market-changing products, technologies, and companies. We have already founded 4 companies. Our ventures are independent business units that benefit from each other’s technologies, expertise, and market access to become even more successful: adjoe is developing a breakthrough mobile advertising solution that enables app publishers around the world to grow their advertising revenues. justDice is the market leader in Mobile Gaming Loyalty Programs. Sunday is a next-generation hybrid casual mobile game publisher. And justtrack offers unique software to automate the entire mobile user acquisition process. Yet more to come.

Under the umbrella of the media company Bertelsmann, we have access to a global network of experts and strong financial support. By developing a state-of-the-art tech stack and highly skilled workforce, we aim to reach more mobile users than any other company in the world. If you want to grow your career in tech, challenge yourself in a high-performance environment, while having fun with great colleagues from all over the world, you've come to the right place!

Find the whole world in one office. Boost your career with awesome people!

What you will do:

  • Together with the Office team, you are responsible for the well-being of our 380+ employees in Hamburg and creating a superb work environment for them

  • You will be one of the contact persons for all colleagues with any office-related questions or feedback

  • You keep things in order and are always aware of what’s needed to maintain a great office environment

  • You monitor stock levels of office supplies, food & drinks and make timely orders to ensure that essentials are always available

  • You help to organize exciting events, from team get-togethers to big celebrations like our annual Christmas party

  • You coordinate repairs and maintenance in the offices, keep in contact with facility managers as well as cleaning services

  • You help to manage our in-house gym and our trainer schedule

  • You welcome national and international guests, ensuring they feel comfortable and prepare meeting rooms accordingly

  • You support the onboarding of new employees and provide keys to them

  • Depending on your experience and interests, take over responsibility for your own projects

Who you are:

  • You like to help, and you are service- and solution-oriented

  • You are engaged, proactive, and you like to take over responsibility for your own projects

  • You love working in a team and jumping in where a hand is needed

  • You know how to keep yourself organized and can adjust multiple tasks flexibly

  • You are diligent and enjoy bringing things into order - whether it’s organizing events, sorting things out, or stocking our office fridges

  • You have an eye for the small details, always ensuring that nothing is left unchecked or forgotten

  • You have some experience from working in the service-, hospitality- or gastronomy area or in offices

  • Ideally, you have expertise in relevant areas, e.g. event management, building and office administration, as well as basic craftsman skills

  • You communicate in German in a conversational level and fluent English abilities

  • You know how to use common communication tools

  • On-site Commitment: This role is 100% on-site at our Hamburg headquarters to ensure effective communication and hands-on management. But no worries, our office is amazing!

Fuel for the Journey: Benefits to Support Your Ambitions

  • Invest in Your Future: Regular feedback and our development program support your growth, helping you expand your skill set and achieve your career goals.

  • Easy Arrival to applike: From signing to settling in Hamburg, we’ve got you covered. Need a visa? No problem. Ready to build your new life and career at applike in Hamburg? We support every ambition - from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you settle in and make Hamburg feel like home.

  • Live Your Best Life, at Work and Beyond: Flexible working hours. Enjoy 30 vacation days, and free access to an in-house gym with lots of different fitness classes and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

  • Thrive Where You Work: Enjoy the Alster Lake view from our central office with top-notch equipment, fun open spaces, and a large variety of snacks and drinks.

  • Join the Community! Participate in regular team and company events, including hackathons and social gatherings. We work together, and we celebrate together, too.

The Interview Process:

  • 1st: Interview with TA

  • 2nd: Team Lead Office Management

  • 3rd: Getting to know the Office Team and Managing Director

Our mission is to create an inspiring work environment for amazing people to achieve extraordinary things. Be part of it!

Skip writing cover letters. Tell us about your most passionate personal project, your desired salary, and your earliest possible start date. We are looking forward to your application!

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

title: Deployment Strategist (Munich Office)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Dataleap
description_html:
About Dataleap
We're the agentic operating system for the enterprise. We enable business teams to build, scale, and manage the most capable AI employees on the market.

We raised $3M from YC and angels like Aravind (CEO Perplexity) and Rahul Vohra (Superhuman). We have thousands of agents running at 2,000+ person scale-ups and Fortune 500 companies. We have PMF and are doubling revenue every month. We have far more demand than we can handle.

About the role
I'm Sacha, Chief of Staff at Dataleap. I own our existing customers, and I need someone alongside me to make our current accounts win with Dataleap.

This isn't a sales role. Your job is to make the customers we already have wildly successful, to walk into their organizations, find the people who want to build agents, and help them actually do it. You'll run adoption on the ground: sit with teams, understand their work, build agents alongside them, unblock them, and turn curious users into daily believers. When a customer succeeds, it's because you made it happen.

We're building out our German office, and this is the moment to get in. You'll work directly with me and our team on the ground. As we scale, this role has a real path to grow into a full-time role in the Growth team at Dataleap, more ownership, bigger accounts, deeper work. This is your chance to show what you've got, and I'll make sure it's the fastest growth of your career.

What you'll own

  • Customer adoption. Drive real usage inside our existing accounts. Find the champions, enable them, and help them pay it forward across their org.

  • Building agents alongside customers. Sit with their teams, understand the messy details of their work, and build agents in Dataleap that solve real problems. You prove the value by shipping it.

  • Being the trusted partner. Become the person our customers love to have in the room, the one who gets their world, makes them better, and makes them feel taken care of.

  • Training and enablement. Run workshops, hackathons, and hands-on sessions that turn non-technical teams into confident agent builders.

  • Being the voice of the customer. Feed what you learn back to me, product, and engineering. Push hard for what our customers need.

  • Automate your own role with Dataleap. We build AI employees for a living, and you'll live in the product you're helping customers adopt. Build agents that eliminate the manual parts of your own job instead of doing them by hand.

Who you are

  • Hungry and proactive. You don't wait to be told. You see what needs doing and you're already on it.

  • Great with people. You're warm, confident, and easy to trust. You can walk into a room of people you've never met and have them rooting for you by the end.

  • Someone customers fall for. The bar is simple: I want customers coming back to me saying "I love this person, what a great hire." You make people feel understood and supported.

  • Super AI-native. You breathe AI. You build agents for everything and you're already living in these tools, not just exploring them.

  • A culture carrier. You embody how we work and represent Dataleap brilliantly out in the world.

  • High agency, low ego. There's unsexy work and you'll do it without flinching. You want to work hard and be part of something ambitious.

  • You speak German at a native level and are fluent in English. Based in Munich or ready to move here.

How we work
This is your life's work right now, and mine too. We operate like athletes: we take care of ourselves and our bodies, and we work hard and win. High standards, high output, no excuses, and we enjoy the ride together.

What this is not

  • Not a coffee-and-shadowing internship, you'll own real customer relationships from week one.

  • Not a back-office role, you're in front of customers, in their offices, in the work.

  • Not for someone who needs rigid structure or waits to be told what to do.

What you get

  • A front-row seat to how AI gets deployed inside real companies, at the absolute frontier.

  • Direct work with me and exposure to our network at YC, Founders Inc, and CDTM.

  • A real path to full-time: grow into a full-time role in the Growth team at Dataleap as we scale.

  • Unlimited AI budget. We practice what we preach.

  • Frequent proof that your work matters, straight from the customers you win over.

How we hire (fast, ~2 weeks start to finish)

  1. Get to know me (Sacha).

  2. Meet the team.

  3. A take-home on a real problem we're facing.

  4. Offer, and you're in.

If this resonates, reach out.

title: Contract & Claim Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at ILF Consulting Engineers Germany GmbH
description_html:
Ein Team, in dem man sich wohlfühlt:

Wir sind ein mittelständisches Familienunternehmen mit 500 Mitarbeitenden an verschiedenen Standorten in Deutschland. Als Ingenieurs- und Beratungsdienstleister sind wir weltweit in Projekten tätig, welche die Energiewende vorantreiben, den Schutz der Umwelt fördern und zur Verbesserung unser aller Lebensqualität beitragen.

Die Position ist in unserer Abteilung Contract & Claim Management angesiedelt (aktuell ca. 4 Mitarbeitende). Sie übernehmen als Contract & Claim Manager (m/w/d) an den Standorten Bremen oder München eine zentrale Rolle in der Bearbeitung und Steuerung von HOAI-basierten Verträgen und Schadensfällen.

Aufgaben, die motivieren

  • Schadenmanagement & Regulierung: Prüfung und Bearbeitung von Ansprüchen bei Ingenieurverträgen nach HOAI, inklusive Verhandlungen und Streitbeilegung bei Leistungsabweichungen oder Kostenüberschreitungen.

  • Vertragsmanagement: Erstellung, Prüfung und Anpassung von Verträgen unter Berücksichtigung der HOAI und des deutschen Vertragsrechts.

  • Honorar & Kostenkontrolle: Beratung zu HOAI-Honoraren, Unterstützung bei Kostenprognosen und -kontrolle während des Projektverlaufs.

  • Streitbeilegung: Zentrale Anlaufstelle für die Klärung von Vertragsstreitigkeiten im HOAI-Kontext.

  • Dokumentation & Reporting: Erstellung von Berichten und Sicherstellung einer lückenlosen Dokumentation für interne und rechtliche Zwecke.

  • Kommunikation & Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit Projektteams, Rechtsabteilung und externen Partnern zur Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe.

  • Schulung & Wissenstransfer: Weitergabe von Best Practices im Vertrags- und Schadenmanagement an Projektteams

Qualifikationen, die überzeugen:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Jura, Baumanagement, Wirtschaftsrecht, Architektur, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Vertrags- und/oder Schadenmanagement,idealerweise mit Bezug zur HOAI

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im deutschen Vertragsrecht (insbesondere HOAI und BGB)

  • Fähigkeit mehrere Verträge zu verwalten

  • Verbindliches Auftreten, Verhandlungsgeschick, Teamfähigkeit

  • Analytisches Denkvermögen, Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit

  • Konfliktlösungsfähigkeit

  • sehr gute Deutsch- und Englisch-Kenntnisse (min. C1)


91% unserer Mitarbeitenden stimmen der Aussage zu, dass ILF in Deutschland ein "Great Place to work" ist:

  • Sympathische Unternehmenskultur und gelebte VIeLFalt: Viele lokale aber auch überregionale Live-Events prägen unser Miteinander und der Großteil der Mitarbeitenden ist per "Du". Besonders stolz macht uns die Internationalität unseres Teams mit mehr als 30 unterschiedlichen Nationen.

  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung: An allen Standorten sind unsere Arbeitsplätze technisch hochwertig und mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen ausgestattet. Auch wenn es uns von anderen Unternehmen vielleicht nicht unterscheidet: Wir bieten freie Getränke, den obligatorischen Obstkorb und weitere Snacks für Zwischendurch inklusive Eis im Sommer.

  • Entwicklung und Netzwerken: Wir planen für alle Mitarbeitenden jährliche Weiterbildungsbudgets ein, die für externe Angebote (z.B. Udemy) und unsere interne ILF-Academy genutzt werden können. Außerdem wird in regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen auf Wunsch die Möglichkeit neuer oder erweiterter Verantwortungsbereiche besprochen. Unsere Nachwuchskräfte treffen sich regelmäßig im Club der Jungingenieur:innen.

  • Über das Gehalt hinaus: Wir beteiligen unsere Mitarbeitenden an Unternehmensgewinnen, honorieren Mitarbeiterempfehlungen sowie Fachartikel und -vorträge mit großzügigen Prämien und würdigen herausragende Projekte mit unseren Excellence Awards. Zusätzlich kann sich jeder Mitarbeitende wahlweise für eine Pluxee Guthabenkarte, eine Zusatzkrankenversicherung oder den EGYM-Wellpass entscheiden.

  • Gesund und nachhaltig: Wir erstatten die monatlichen Kosten für das Jobticket und bieten die Option auf Bike-Leasing. Außerdem bezuschussen wir die Mitgliedschaft in einem Fitnessstudio und Arbeitsplatzbrillen. Bei Fragen aus allen Lebensbereichen bekommen Sie mit unserem externen Employee Assistance Program unkomplizierte und schnelle Unterstützung.

  • Work-Life-Balance: Für individuelle Bedürfnisse in allen Lebenslagen finden wir passende Lösungen in Bezug auf Arbeitszeit (flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung inkl. Gleitzeitkonto und verschiedene Teilzeitvarianten) und Arbeitsort (z.B. mobiles Arbeiten, Standortwechsel, Auslandseinsätze). Zusätzlich zu 30 Urlaubstagen und Sonderurlaubstagen bei besonderen Anlässen wie z.B.  Hochzeit oder Umzug sind Heiligabend und Silvester jedes Jahr frei.

  • Internationalität & Vielfalt: Wir sind Teil der von den Gründerfamilien geführten ILF Gruppe mit über 45 Standorten und mehr als 3.700 Mitarbeitenden und arbeiten in nationalen sowie internationalen Projekten mit diversen Teams aus über 30 Nationen.

Überzeugt? Dann werden Sie Teil von Engineering Excellence und senden uns Ihre Bewerbung über den untenstehenden Button!

Weitere Fragen? Noch mehr über uns und unseren Bewerbungsprozess erfahren Sie hier.

Als Senior Project Manager BESS /m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Batteriespeicherprojekte in Deutschland und begleiten diese von der Planung bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme. Zur Vertstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir engagierte Persönlichkeiten an verschiedenen Standorten deutschlandweit, die mir ihrer Expertise den Ausbau moderner Energiespeicherlösungen vorantreiben möchten.

Aufgaben, die motivieren:

  • Projektmanagement von BESS-Projekten (Battery Energy Storage Systems) mit Schwerpunkt auf dem deutschen Markt

  • Erfahrung mit den deutschen Genehmigungsanforderungen (z. B. BImSchG/BImSchV)

  • Unterstützung der Beschaffung sowie Leitung von Ausschreibungs- und Vergabeverfahren

  • Unterstützung während der Bau- und Inbetriebnahmephase

  • Koordination von Nachunternehmern sowie Sicherstellung von QA/QC (Qualitätssicherung und Qualitätskontrolle)

  • Unterstützung des Vertriebsteams bei der Akquise neuer Projekte

Qualifikationen, die überzeugen:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Erneuerbare Energien, Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

  • 6–8 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich elektrotechnischer Anlagen in Deutschland

  • Erfahrung in der Planung von Anlagen im Bereich der erneuerbaren Energien, Batteriespeichersystemen (BESS) oder anderen elektrotechnischen Anlagen in Deutschland

  • Deutsch-, und Englischkenntnisse auf C1 Niveau

  • Reisebreitschaft

  • Führerschein notwendig

Worüber wir uns freuen: Wenn Sie für Ihren Job brennen, egal welcher ethnischen Herkunft, Religion oder Weltanschauung Sie angehören. Auch Geschlecht, Behinderung, Alter oder sexuelle Identität spielen für uns keine Rolle. Hauptsache, Sie passen zu uns!


91% unserer Mitarbeitenden stimmen der Aussage zu, dass ILF in Deutschland ein "Great Place to work" ist:

  • Sympathische Unternehmenskultur und gelebte VIeLFalt: Viele lokale aber auch überregionale Live-Events prägen unser Miteinander und der Großteil der Mitarbeitenden ist per "Du". Besonders stolz macht uns die Internationalität unseres Teams mit mehr als 30 unterschiedlichen Nationen.

  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung: An allen Standorten sind unsere Arbeitsplätze technisch hochwertig und mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen ausgestattet. Auch wenn es uns von anderen Unternehmen vielleicht nicht unterscheidet: Wir bieten freie Getränke, den obligatorischen Obstkorb und weitere Snacks für Zwischendurch inklusive Eis im Sommer.

  • Entwicklung und Netzwerken: Wir planen für alle Mitarbeitenden jährliche Weiterbildungsbudgets ein, die für externe Angebote (z.B. Udemy) und unsere interne ILF-Academy genutzt werden können. Außerdem wird in regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen auf Wunsch die Möglichkeit neuer oder erweiterter Verantwortungsbereiche besprochen. Unsere Nachwuchskräfte treffen sich regelmäßig im Club der Jungingenieur:innen.

  • Über das Gehalt hinaus: Wir beteiligen unsere Mitarbeitenden an Unternehmensgewinnen, honorieren Mitarbeiterempfehlungen sowie Fachartikel und -vorträge mit großzügigen Prämien und würdigen herausragende Projekte mit unseren Excellence Awards.  Zusätzlich kann sich jeder Mitarbeitende wahlweise für eine Pluxee Guthabenkarte, eine Zusatzkrankenversicherung oder den EGYM-Wellpass entscheiden.

  • Gesund und nachhaltig: Wir erstatten die monatlichen Kosten für das Jobticket und bieten die Option auf Bike-Leasing. Außerdem bezuschussen wir die Mitgliedschaft in einem Fitnessstudio und Arbeitsplatzbrillen. Bei Fragen aus allen Lebensbereichen bekommen Sie mit unserem externen Employee Assistance Program unkomplizierte und schnelle Unterstützung.

  • Work-Life-Balance: Für individuelle Bedürfnisse in allen Lebenslagen finden wir passende Lösungen in Bezug auf Arbeitszeit (flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung inkl. Gleitzeitkonto und verschiedene Teilzeitvarianten) und Arbeitsort (z.B. mobiles Arbeiten, Standortwechsel, Auslandseinsätze). Zusätzlich zu 30 Urlaubstagen und Sonderurlaubstagen bei besonderen Anlässen wie z.B.  Hochzeit oder Umzug sind Heiligabend und Silvester jedes Jahr frei.

  • Internationalität & Vielfalt: Wir sind Teil der von den Gründerfamilien geführten ILF Gruppe mit über 45 Standorten und mehr als 3.700 Mitarbeitenden und arbeiten in nationalen sowie internationalen Projekten mit diversen Teams aus über 30 Nationen.

description_html:
DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Recherche zu planungsrechtlichen, genehmigungsrelevanten und projektspezifischen Fragestellungen
  • Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung von Windenergie- und Photovoltaikprojekten
  • Mitwirkung bei der Identifikation und Bewertung geeigneter Standorte sowie bei der Entwicklung von Standortkonzepten
  • Unterstützung bei der Koordination interner und externer Projektbeteiligter, Fachgutachter, Planungsbüros und weiterer Dienstleister
  • Vorbereitung von Unterlagen und Präsentationen für Kommunen, Behörden, Eigentümer und weitere Projektbeteiligte
  • Unterstützung bei der Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung von Projektfortschritten
  • Mitwirkung bei der Weiterentwicklung interner Prozesse und Standards


DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Laufendes Studium im Bereich Naturwissenschaften, Raumplanung, Geografie, Erneuerbare Energien oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung
  • Erste praktische Erfahrungen in einer ähnlichen Tätigkeit von Vorteil 
  • Interesse an erneuerbaren Energien und Windenergieprojekten
  • Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Blick fürs Detail
  • Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie die Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse verständlich zu dokumentieren und im Team zu diskutieren
  • Sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere Excel
  • Erste Erfahrungen im Umgang mit GIS-Software sind von Vorteil
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2 gemäß GER) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Verfügbarkeit von mindestens 12 Monaten sowie mindestens 13 Wochenstunden (flexible Arbeitszeiteinteilung)



DAS BIETEN WIR

  • Eine spannende, facettenreiche und interdisziplinäre Tätigkeit mit großen kreativem Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Persönliches Mentoring und eine steile Lernkurve: Durch eine positive Feedbackkultur und ein wertvolles Zusammenarbeiten entwickelst Du Dich stetig weiter
  • Eine einzigartige Unternehmenskultur in einem hochmotivierten und interdisziplinären Team
  • Ein Inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld in einem hellen, modernen Büro in der Dresdner Neustadt
  • Attraktive Vergütung: 16 €/h
  • Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung
  • Chance auf ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis bei beiderseitigem Interesse

ÜBER UNS
 
Mit uniPlan energy treiben wir innerhalb der uniPlan gruppe die Energiewende aktiv voran. Als Family Office mit Sitz in Dresden entwickeln und steuern wir als Gruppe mit uniPlan management, uniPlan energy und uniPlan immobilien Projekte in den Bereichen erneuerbare Energien und Immobilien. 
Innerhalb der uniPlan energy entwickeln wir vorrangig in Deutschland, aber auch in Teilen Europas, gemeinsam mit Kommunen, Unternehmen und Flächeneigentümer:innen Wind-, Photovoltaik- und Speicherprojekte - von der Flächensicherung bis hin zur Umsetzung. Dabei setzen wir auf Qualität, partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und regionale Verankerung. Besonders wichtig: Unsere Projekte entwickeln wir für den eigenen Bestand und legen damit den Grundstein, um Schritt für Schritt zum Grünstromversorger zu werden - ein Ansatz, der auf Beständigkeit und langfristige Entwicklung ausgerichtet ist.
 
 Unser Morgen braucht Dich. Werde Teil unseres uniPlan Teams.

title: Team Lead Analytics & Risk (m/f/d)

description_html:
Why The Mobility House?

  • Help shape our vision of an emission-free energy and mobility future 
  • High levelof responsibility and rapid development in a growing and innovative company
  • Open, diverse & international team
  • Flexible working hours and additional vacation days
  • Mobile working from home and 20 days in other European countries 
  • Choice between the latest Apple and Dell IT equipment
  • Subsidy for Deutschlandticket job
  • Wellpass membership
  • Lease of your preferred car and bike via FINN or JobRad
  • Modern office with good public transport connections
  • and much more!


What you do

We optimise and market a growing portfolio of flexible assets on European power markets - battery storage, aggregated EV fleets and renewable generation. Our multi-market optimisation and execution is purely algorithm-driven and fully automated. What decides whether we make money is the quality of our market view: price patterns, forecasts, fundamental models and the assessment of risk.

  • You own price and generation forecasting across and keep the short-term and long-term views consistent
  • You develop and implement analytical models and forecasting tools to assess electricity and renewable energy markets as well as delivery data-driven insights and signals for our trading decisions  
  • You assess market trends, regulatory developments and new markets quantitatively, providing the basis for country and product decisions
  • You lead a team of 5-7 analysts & data scientist, develop them technically and coach them in their personal growth
  • You work closely with Trading Desk, Portfolio Management, Pricing, Sales and Product, building the bridge to develop cutting edge products and services
  • You create reports, monitorings and benchmarks to derive actionable insights for trading, senior management and other stakeholders
  •  your models feed into bids and prices largely automatically, and into the decisions of the management board
  • You own risk: the limit system, the monitoring of positions and exposures, scenario and stress-test methodology, and risk reporting to the Head of Trading and the management board


Who you are

  • Several years of experience in quantitative analysis on European power markets - forecasting, fundamental modelling or risk
  • A solid understanding of day-ahead, intraday and ancillary services, capacity and local flexibility markets, and of how prices form in them
  • Experience in technical leadership - or a clearly visible step towards it - with the ability to motivate and develop a team
  • The ability to translate quantitative findings so that the management board and stakeholders can make decisions based on them
  • business-fluent English and German is a plus 


Are you a good fit for us?

Diversity enriches our team and makes us stronger. Regardless of origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, religion, or any disability – everyone is welcome here! We look forward to receiving your application and achieving great things together.

  • Drive overall architecture data hygiene, observability, and long-term business adoption and impact of all our AI systems.

Who you are

  • Relentless builder with a bias for action who loves implementing functional prototypes rapidly and refines them into reliable, production-grade systems. 
  • Strong backend coding skills (e.g., Python), REST APIs, microservices, databases, and modern cloud infrastructure (AWS). 
  • Deeply fascinated by the AI landscape, thriving on weekly self-driven experimentation with new models, agentic frameworks and emerging tools and approaches. 
  • Instinctively zooms out from single use cases to recognize recurring patterns and translate them into modular platform tools and scalable architecture 
  • Quickly grasp complex, unfamiliar operational and business focussed workflows, asking the right questions to spot where AI actually adds real business value.

Wir schaffen Mitarbeitenden ein attraktives Umfeld, das von starkem Teamzusammenhalt und Can-Do-Mentalität geprägt ist. Die Unternehmenskultur von MaxSolar bietet die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, sich persönlich weiterzuentwickeln und die klimaneutrale Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Du hast Erfahrung als Projektleiter*in im Bereich Anlagenbau und verfügst idealerweise über Praxiskenntnisse im Bereich PV-Aufdachanlagen (> 500 kWp)

title: Werkstudent*in Strategy / Research (w/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Hirschen Group GmbH
description_html:
Wer wir sind.

Eine der führenden Kommunikationsagenturen im deutschen Raum mit mehr als 300 Mitarbeiter*innen. Wir bieten das ganze Paket: Konzeption, Kreation, Redaktion, Organisation, Kampagnen, Social-Media und technologische Plattformen. Wir begleiten Kund*innen aus Wirtschaft, Politik, Gesellschaft und Medien. Und wir entwickeln alles, was diese für eine wirksame Kommunikation brauchen: Social Media-Kampagnen, Magazine, Fernsehspots und Websites. Von der strategischen Kernidee bis zur technischen Umsetzung. Am liebsten für die komplexen Themen unserer Zeit.


Was zu tun ist.

  • Recherche von zielgruppengerechten Insights  
  • Zuarbeit bei der Entwicklung von Marken- und Kommunikationsstrategien 
  • Zuarbeit bei der Entwicklung von Customer Journey(s)
  • Recherche und Bewertung von wesentlichen Konsum-, Konsument*innen- und Gesellschaftstrends 
  • Zuarbeit bei der Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung von qualitativen und quantitativen Forschungsdesigns  
  • Zuarbeit bei der Definition und Analyse von relevanten Marken- und Kampagnen-KPIs


Was du mitbringst.

Du absolvierst gerade ein Studium in Marketing, Wirtschaftspsychologie oder Psychologie, Kommunikations- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder in einem vergleichbaren Bereich und möchtest uns unterstützen. Traumhaft wären erste praktische Erfahrungen in Form von Praktika. Ist aber kein Muss.

Was viel wichtiger ist: Du hast Lust. Auf Menschen, Marken, Zielgruppen, Zeitgeschehen und vor allem Daten.
Auch wichtig: Du bist klar im Denken, in der Analyse auf den Punkt. Du weißt, wie du komplexe Themen auf wenig Platz pointiert zusammenfasst. Und jetzt kommt’s: Du hast Spaß an Daten und daran, dich mit ihnen auseinanderzusetzen. Tracking-Daten, Social Listening, Suchvolumina, Meinungs- und Marktforschung. Jetzt weißt du, wofür deine Statistik-Vorlesungen gut waren. 
Damit leistest du einen wichtigen Beitrag, um spannende Insights zu finden, auf deren Basis punktgenaue Creative Briefs oder Analysen erstellt werden können.  

Bei aller Liebe zur Teamarbeit kannst du auch eigenständig arbeiten und die dir übertragenen Aufgaben gewissenhaft und eigenverantwortlich umsetzen.


Wen wir suchen.

Eine*n Werkstudent*in für den Bereich Strategy / Research. In Berlin. Ab sofort, gerne bald. Für eine Zusammenarbeit von mindestens 18 Monaten.


Was wir bieten.

Wir sind ein kleines schlagkräftiges Kernteam bestehend aus Beratung, Kreation, Strategie und Digital Services. Aus diesen Disziplinen bilden wir interdisziplinäre Projektteams, die wir bei Bedarf durch unser ausgewähltes Netzwerk an Expert*innen in den Bereichen Daten und Psychographie, Mediastrategie und -buchungen und Produktion erweitern. Durch diese kurzen Wege und flexiblen Prozesse sind wir agil und können schnell, proaktiv und eng mit unseren Kund*innen zusammenarbeiten. 

Wir leben eine offene und lebendige Agenturkultur, in der dein individueller Beitrag zählt, um zusammen mit Empathie und Spaß zu den wirklich guten Lösungen und Ergebnissen zu kommen. Bei uns darfst du genauso sein, wie du bist.

Wenn du nach deinem Studium bleiben willst, wäre das ein Win-Win für beide Seiten.


Was, wenn's passt?

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.
  
Wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung von qualifizierten Menschen. Jeder geschlechtlichen und sexuellen Identität. Jeglicher Religionszugehörigkeit. Jeden Alters. Von Bewerbenden mit Migrationshintergrund, People of Colour und/oder Menschen mit Behinderungen. Wiedereinsteiger*innen. Eltern. Quereinsteiger*innen. Alle sind bei uns gleichermaßen willkommen.
  
Schick uns gerne deine Bewerbungsunterlagen und lass uns wissen, wer du bist. Wenn du möchtest, kannst du deine Unterlagen auch anonymisiert als Blind-Bewerbung einreichen – wir stellen einen fairen und transparenten Auswahlprozess sicher. Wir freuen uns auf dich.
  
Und noch ein Hinweis: Wir nehmen Informationssicherheit ernst – und freuen uns, wenn du diesen Anspruch mit uns teilst.


Deine Ansprechpartnerin.

Anette Lezak.

Unsere Leidenschaft sind technologische Lösungen, die schon heute wirken und einen bleibenden Mehrwert stiften. Je komplexer, desto besser. Was du mitbringst.

  • ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine äquivalente Ausbildung mit mehrjähriger relevanter Berufspraxis

  • exzellente Kenntnisse in TYPO3 und TYPO3-Frameworks (u.a. Extbase, Fluid, TypoScript) - deine Westentasche

    • relational Databases: MySQL/Maria DB/PostgreSQL
    • Extension-Entwicklung und Architektur eigener TYPO3-Erweiterungen mittels Composer-Struktur
    • Schnittstellen-Konfiguration wie Anbindung externer APIs (REST, JSON, XML) und Services (u.a. Apache Solr)
  • ebenso wichtig: wirtschaftliches Denken, Kommunikationsfreude, Gewissenhaftigkeit
  • sichere praktische Erfahrung in agilen Arbeitsweisen, Scrum oder Kanban
Worauf wir außerdem nicht verzichten möchten sind Teamgeist, Zuverlässigkeit und reichlich Bock Neues zu lernen. Und du so?


Wen wir suchen.

TYPO3 Developer - Senior & Mid-Level (m/w/d/k.A.) Ab sofort.   In Dresden, Berlin oder Gütersloh.


Was wir bieten.

Keine Schokoriegel, sondern digitale Erlebnisse. Keine Turnschuhe, sondern Fitness für die graue Zellen. Weil: komplexe Themen – anspruchsvolle Kund:innen.  

Was noch? Kluge und sympathische Kolleg:innen. Relevante Auftraggebende. Inhaltlich Herausforderndes. Reichlich Abwechslung. Flache Hierarchien. Und die Chance gemeinsam mit uns kräftig aufs Gas zu drücken. Wir stehen für familienfreundliches Arbeiten. Raum für individuelle Weiterentwicklung und fachbezogene Veranstaltungen. Wir leben mobiles Arbeiten. Lieben aber auch unsere Offices, denn einiges klappt besser gemeinsam vor Ort.

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung von qualifizierten Menschen. Jeder geschlechtlichen und sexuellen Identität. Jeden Alters. Jeglicher Religionszugehörigkeit. Von Bewerbenden mit Migrationshintergrund, People of Colour und / oder Menschen mit Behinderungen. Wiedereinsteiger:innen. Eltern. Quereinsteiger:innen. Alle sind bei uns gleichermaßen willkommen.

Schick uns gerne deine Bewerbungsunterlagen und lass uns wissen, wann du frühestens einsteigen kannst und wo deine Gehaltsvorstellungen liegen. Wenn du möchtest, kannst du deine Unterlagen auch anonymisiert als Blind-Bewerbung einreichen – wir stellen einen fairen und transparenten Auswahlprozess sicher. Wir freuen uns auf dich.

Als Client Service Director trägst du bei uns die strategische, wirtschaftliche und kundenbezogene Gesamtverantwortung für eines unserer zentralen Mandate im Public Sector – an der Schnittstelle von Kund*innenberatung, Account Development und digitaler Delivery, unterstützt von einem erfahrenen Team aus Projektmanagement, Beratung, UX/UI, Technologie und Betrieb.
 
Was du verantwortest

  • Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Beziehungen zu Entscheider*innen und zentralen Ansprechpartner*innen
  • tiefgreifendes Verständnis der Ziele, Roadmaps und Herausforderungen unserer Kund*innen, frühzeitige Reaktion und Lösungsvorschläge statt auf fertige Anfragen zu warten
  • Proaktive Entwicklung neuer Themen und Beratungsangebote (z. B. Plattform-Weiterentwicklung, UX, Technologie, Redaktionsprozesse, KI)
  • Verantwortung für Umsatz, Deckungsbeitrag und Forecast
  • Übergeordnete Begleitung großer Projekte, Unterstützung der Projektmanager*innen bei Meilensteinen und Eskalationen
  • Ausrichtung des kund*innenbezogenen Kernteams, Einbindung passender Spezialist*innen
  • Erkennen von Synergien, damit erfolgreiche Lösungen auch an anderer Stelle Mehrwert schaffen
  • Die operative Projektleitung liegt bei unseren Projektmanager*innen – du behältst die Perspektive auf das Gesamtmandat.


Was du mitbringst.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer Digitalagentur, Digitalberatung oder vergleichbarem Umfeld
  • Erfahrung mit öffentlichen Auftraggeber*innen und Verständnis für Verwaltung und öffentliche Kommunikation
  • Erfahrung in der Beratung anspruchsvoller Kund*innen sowie mit größeren Website-, CMS- oder Plattformprojekten
  • Wirtschaftliches und unternehmerisches Denken, ausgeprägtes Gespür für Kund*innenbedarfe

  • Du musst heute noch keinen vergleichbaren Großaccount vollständig verantwortet haben – die Position eignet sich auch als nächster Schritt für erfahrene Senior Consultants, Account Manager*innen oder Senior Project Manager*innen mit dem Wunsch nach mehr strategischer und wirtschaftlicher Verantwortung.

Was die Rolle besonders macht
  • Ein großes, langfristig angelegtes Mandat mit erheblichem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Ein festes Kernteam, das du um weitere Spezialist*innen ergänzen kannst.

Eine*n Client Service Director für den Public Sector. Ab sofort. Mit beruflichem Schwerpunkt in der Region Rheinland-Pfalz/Mainz

Und noch ein Hinweis: Wir nehmen Informationssicherheit ernst – und freuen uns, wenn du diesen Anspruch mit uns teilst.


Deine Ansprechpartnerin.

Nicole Lilie
